title: 12-DAY RWANDA AT A GLANCE SAFARI - CULTURE, LAKE KIVU, GORILLAS & AKAGERA WILDLIFE EXPERIENCE
overview: This 12-day private Rwanda safari offers a complete exploration of the "Land of a Thousand Hills," combining cultural experiences, breathtaking landscapes, rainforest adventures, lakeside relaxation, conservation experiences, and wildlife encounters. The journey takes you through Rwanda's most iconic destinations including Kigali, Nyungwe National Park, Lake Kivu, Volcanoes National Park, and Akagera National Park. Discover Rwanda's history and culture in Kigali and Nyanza, explore the ancient Nyungwe rainforest through canopy walk and waterfall hiking, experience the beauty of Lake Kivu, learn about gorilla conservation at the Dian Fossey Campus, explore the volcanic region of Musanze, and finish with an exciting safari in Akagera National Park. This package is ideal for travelers looking for a complete Rwanda experience combining nature, culture, adventure, and wildlife.
facts: Tour Name: Rwanda at a Glance Safari Duration: 12 Days / 11 Nights Country: Rwanda Tour Type: Private Safari Starting Point: Kigali International Airport Ending Point: Kigali International Airport Travel Style: Wildlife, Culture, Nature & Adventure Main Destinations: • Kigali • Nyungwe National Park • Karongi (Kibuye) • Rubavu (Gisenyi) • Volcanoes National Park • Akagera National Park Activities: City Tour, Museums, Canopy Walk, Waterfall Hiking, Tea Experience, Boat Cruise, Hot Springs, Cultural Visit, Conservation Experience, Game Drive, Boat Safari
highlights: Explore Kigali's history, culture, and local markets
Visit Kigali Genocide Memorial and Kandt House Museum
Discover Rwanda's royal heritage at King's Palace Museum
Explore Nyungwe rainforest and its biodiversity
Experience the famous Nyungwe Canopy Walkway
Hike to beautiful waterfalls inside Nyungwe Forest
Visit Gisakura Tea Plantation
Enjoy Lake Kivu boat cruise and island visits
Experience traditional fishing with local fishermen
Visit Gorilla Guardians Village for cultural interaction
Explore Dian Fossey Tomb and Ellen Campus conservation center
Discover Akagera National Park wildlife
Enjoy Lake Ihema boat cruise with hippos and crocodiles

days.heading: DAY 1: ARRIVAL IN KIGALI - TRANSFER TO HOTEL
days.body: Upon arrival at Kigali International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by your safari guide. After a short briefing about your Rwanda adventure, transfer to your hotel for dinner and overnight. Accommodation: Mille Collines Hotel Meals: Dinner

days.heading: DAY 2: KIGALI CITY EXPLORATION & CULTURAL EXPERIENCE
days.body: After breakfast, start your Kigali city tour. Explore Rwanda's history from the pre-colonial period, colonial era, post-colonial period, and the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi. Visit: Kigali Genocide Memorial A powerful memorial site dedicated to remembering victims of the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi. Kandt House Museum Visit the former residence of Richard Kandt and learn about Rwanda before and during the colonial period. Kimironko Market Experience local life through one of Kigali's busiest traditional markets. Return to the hotel for dinner and overnight. Accommodation: Mille Collines Hotel Meals: Breakfast & Dinner

days.heading: DAY 3: TRANSFER TO NYUNGWE NATIONAL PARK VIA NYANZA & BUTARE
days.body: After breakfast, depart Kigali towards Nyungwe National Park. En route visit: King's Palace Museum - Nyanza Discover Rwanda's traditional monarchy, royal history, and the famous Inyambo long-horned cattle tradition. Ethnographic Museum - Huye Explore one of Africa's finest ethnographic collections displaying Rwanda's culture, history, and traditions. Continue to Nyungwe National Park. Accommodation: Nyungwe Top View Hotel Meals: Breakfast & Dinner

days.heading: DAY 4: NYUNGWE CANOPY WALK & WATERFALL HIKE
days.body: After breakfast, transfer to Nyungwe Forest for the famous Canopy Walkway experience. The walkway is one of East Africa's highest and longest canopy bridges, suspended approximately 70 meters above the forest floor. Enjoy spectacular views of the rainforest, birds, primates, and surrounding landscapes. After lunch, continue with a guided waterfall hike through the beautiful rainforest trails. Return to the lodge for dinner and overnight. Accommodation: Nyungwe Top View Hotel Meals: Full Board

days.heading: DAY 5: GISAKURA TEA EXPERIENCE - TRANSFER TO KARONGI (KIBUYE)
days.body: After breakfast, visit Gisakura Tea Plantation located near Nyungwe Forest. Enjoy a guided tea experience, learn about tea production, and enjoy beautiful views of the green plantations. You may also spot colobus monkeys living around the plantation area. Continue to Karongi, formerly known as Kibuye, located on the beautiful shores of Lake Kivu. Accommodation: Cormoran Lodge Meals: Breakfast & Dinner

days.heading: DAY 6: LAKE KIVU BOAT CRUISE - TRANSFER TO GISENYI
days.body: After breakfast, enjoy a scenic boat cruise on Lake Kivu. Explore the lake's beautiful islands while enjoying views of surrounding hills and landscapes. Later continue to Rubavu (Gisenyi), a relaxing lakeside town with beautiful beaches and a tropical atmosphere. Accommodation: Galaxy Hotel Meals: Breakfast & Dinner

days.heading: DAY 7: NYAMYUMBA HOT SPRINGS & TRADITIONAL FISHING EXPERIENCE
days.body: After breakfast, visit Nyamyumba Hot Springs. Enjoy this natural attraction known for warm mineral-rich waters and beautiful surroundings. In the evening, experience traditional fishing with local fishermen and learn the techniques used on Lake Kivu. Accommodation: Galaxy Hotel Meals: Breakfast & Dinner

days.heading: DAY 8: TRANSFER TO MUSANZE - GORILLA GUARDIANS CULTURAL EXPERIENCE
days.body: After breakfast, transfer to Musanze, located at the foothills of the Virunga volcanoes. Visit Gorilla Guardians Village (formerly Iby'Iwacu Cultural Village). Experience Rwanda's traditions through: • Traditional dancing • Drumming • Local games • Cultural storytelling • Community interaction Accommodation: Amarembo Lodge Meals: Breakfast & Dinner

days.heading: DAY 9: DIAN FOSSEY TOMBS & ELLEN CAMPUS CONSERVATION EXPERIENCE
days.body: After breakfast, visit the Dian Fossey Tomb site located inside Volcanoes National Park. Enjoy a guided hike to the former research camp and burial site of Dian Fossey while learning about her important contribution to mountain gorilla conservation. After lunch, visit the Ellen Campus of the Dian Fossey Gorilla Fund. Discover modern conservation research, education programs, and efforts protecting mountain gorillas and their habitat. Accommodation: Amarembo Lodge Meals: Breakfast & Dinner

days.heading: DAY 11: AKAGERA GAME DRIVE & LAKE IHEMA BOAT CRUISE
days.body: After breakfast, begin a game drive in Akagera National Park. Search for wildlife including: • Big Five animals • Antelopes • Birds • Reptiles • Scenic landscapes In the afternoon, enjoy a boat cruise on Lake Ihema. Look for: • Hippos • Nile crocodiles • Water birds • Animals along the shoreline Return to the lodge for dinner and overnight. Accommodation: Akagera Game Lodge Meals: Full Board

days.heading: DAY 12: TRANSFER BACK TO KIGALI & DEPARTURE
days.body: After breakfast, drive back to Kigali. Depending on your flight time, transfer to Kigali International Airport for departure.

title: 10 DAYS BEST OF RWANDA SAFARI - GORILLAS, CHIMPANZEES, BIG FIVE & CULTURAL EXPERIENCE
overview: This 10-day Rwanda safari offers the ultimate experience of the "Land of a Thousand Hills," combining Rwanda's rich history, breathtaking landscapes, diverse wildlife, and unforgettable primate encounters. The journey covers Rwanda's top destinations including Kigali, Akagera National Park, Nyungwe Forest National Park, Lake Kivu, and Volcanoes National Park. Experience Kigali's cultural heritage, search for the Big Five in Akagera, explore the ancient Nyungwe rainforest with chimpanzee trekking and canopy walk, enjoy the beauty of Lake Kivu, trek golden monkeys, and complete your adventure with the once-in-a-lifetime mountain gorilla trekking experience. This private safari is ideal for travelers looking for a complete Rwanda adventure combining wildlife, nature, culture, and relaxation.

days.heading: DAY 1: ARRIVAL IN KIGALI AND TRANSFER TO THE HOTEL
days.body: Upon arrival at Kigali International Airport, you will be welcomed by our company representative and professional driver-guide. You will receive a short briefing about your safari before transferring to your hotel for check-in and relaxation. Accommodation: Onomo Hotel Meal Plan: Dinner

days.heading: DAY 2: KIGALI CITY EXPLORATION & CULTURAL EXPERIENCE
days.body: After breakfast, begin your Kigali city exploration. Discover Rwanda's history from the pre-colonial period, colonial era, post-independence period, and the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi. Visit: Kigali Genocide Memorial A significant historical site where more than 250,000 victims of the Genocide against the Tutsi were laid to rest. Kandt House Museum Visit the former residence of Richard Kandt, the first German explorer who settled in Kigali, and learn about Rwanda during the colonial period. Campaign Against Genocide Museum Learn about Rwanda's history and the efforts made to stop the genocide. End the day with a coffee experience at Question Coffee, where you will taste premium Rwandan coffee produced by women cooperatives. Accommodation: Onomo Hotel Meal Plan: Breakfast & Dinner

days.heading: DAY 3: TRANSFER TO AKAGERA NATIONAL PARK - GAME DRIVE & LAKE IHEMA BOAT CRUISE
days.body: After breakfast, transfer to Akagera National Park. Upon arrival, start a game drive searching for Rwanda's wildlife including: • Lions • Rhinos • Leopards • Elephants • Buffaloes • Antelopes • Giraffes • Zebras • Over 500 bird species Akagera is Rwanda's largest national park and offers beautiful savannah landscapes, wetlands, lakes, and wildlife viewing opportunities. After lunch at the lodge, enjoy a thrilling boat cruise on Lake Ihema. Look out for: • Hippos • Nile crocodiles • Water birds • Buffaloes Accommodation: Akagera Game Lodge Meal Plan: Full Board

days.heading: DAY 4: AKAGERA GAME DRIVE & NIGHT GAME DRIVE
days.body: Start the day with an early morning game drive when animals are most active. Search for elephants, birds, antelopes, predators, and other wildlife. Return to the lodge for lunch and relaxation. In the evening, enjoy a night game drive searching for nocturnal animals including: • Leopards • Hyenas • Bush babies • Other nighttime species Accommodation: Akagera Game Lodge Meal Plan: Full Board

days.heading: DAY 5: TRANSFER TO NYUNGWE NATIONAL PARK VIA CULTURAL SITES
days.body: After breakfast, depart Akagera and transfer to Nyungwe National Park. En route visit: King's Palace Museum Discover Rwanda's traditional monarchy and royal history. Ethnographic Museum Learn about Rwanda's culture, traditions, and history. Continue to Nyungwe Forest. Accommodation: Nyungwe Top View Hotel Meal Plan: Breakfast & Dinner

days.heading: DAY 6: CHIMPANZEE TREKKING & NYUNGWE CANOPY WALK
days.body: Early morning breakfast before heading to Nyungwe Forest for chimpanzee trekking. Accompanied by experienced guides, enter the rainforest in search of chimpanzees and other primates. Nyungwe is home to 13 primate species and over 300 bird species. Later enjoy the famous Nyungwe Canopy Walkway, suspended above the rainforest providing spectacular views of the forest ecosystem. Optional visit to a tea plantation. Accommodation: Nyungwe Top View Hotel Meal l Plan: Full Board

days.heading: DAY 7: KAMIRANZOVU SWAMP BIRDWATCHING & TRANSFER TO LAKE KIVU
days.body: Explore Kamiranzovu Swamp, one of Nyungwe's unique ecosystems. Search for rare Albertine Rift bird species including: • Ruwenzori Turaco • Grauer's Swamp Warbler • Other endemic birds After lunch, transfer to Kibuye on Lake Kivu. Enjoy spectacular views of the lake, islands, and surrounding green hills. Accommodation: Bethany Lodge Meal Plan: Full Board

days.heading: DAY 8: LAKE KIVU BOAT CRUISE & TRANSFER TO VOLCANOES NATIONAL PARK
days.body: After breakfast, enjoy a boat cruise on Lake Kivu. Visit: Napoleon Island Famous for fruit bats and birdlife. Amahoro Island Enjoy beautiful lake scenery and learn about Lake Kivu. Later transfer to Volcanoes National Park. Accommodation: Classic Hotel Meal Plan: Breakfast & Dinner

days.heading: DAY 9: GOLDEN MONKEY TREKKING & TWIN LAKES / MUSANZE CAVE VISIT
days.body: After breakfast, transfer to Volcanoes National Park headquarters. Meet Park guides and begin golden monkey trekking. Golden monkeys are rare Albertine Rift endemic primates known for their playful behavior. In the afternoon choose between: • Twin Lakes Burera and Ruhondo visit OR • Musanze Cave exploration Accommodation: Classic Lodge Meal Plan: Full Board

days.heading: DAY 10: GORILLA TREKKING & TRANSFER BACK TO KIGALI
days.body: After breakfast, transfer to Volcanoes National Park headquarters. Complete Park formalities and begin your once-in-a-lifetime mountain gorilla trekking adventure. Trek through the beautiful Virunga forest searching for a habituated gorilla family. Once found, spend one magical hour observing these incredible primates in their natural habitat. After trekking, return for lunch before driving back to Kigali. Depending on your flight schedule, visit souvenir shops including: • Caplaki Art Market • Kimironko Market • Inema Art Center Transfer to Kigali International Airport.

This Rwanda safari is ideal for travelers looking for a complete African adventure featuring gorilla trekking, wildlife viewing, rainforest experiences, and cultural encounters in one of Africa's most beautiful destinations. Continue east toward Akagera National Park, Rwanda's only savannah national park and home to the Big Five. Arrive at your lodge and enjoy the peaceful surroundings. Main Destination: Akagera National Park Activities: Kigali City Tour, Scenic Drive Accommodation: Lodge near Akagera National Park Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

days.body: Start with an early morning game drive searching for wildlife including elephants, lions, buffaloes, giraffes, zebras, antelopes, and many bird species. Later enjoy a boat safari on Lake Ihema where you may see hippos, crocodiles, and numerous water birds. Main Destination: Akagera National Park Activities: Game Drive, Boat Safari Accommodation: Lodge near Akagera National Park Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

days.heading: Day 4: Akagera to Volcanoes National Park
days.body: After breakfast, depart for Volcanoes National Park in northern Rwanda. Enjoy spectacular views of Rwanda's rolling hills, villages, farms, and countryside landscapes. Arrive near the park and prepare for your gorilla trekking adventure. Main Destination: Volcanoes National Park Accommodation: Lodge near Volcanoes National Park Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

days.heading: Day 5: Mountain Gorilla Trekking in Volcanoes National Park
days.body: After breakfast, transfer to the park headquarters for registration and briefing by Rwanda Development Board guides. Begin your gorilla trekking adventure through the beautiful mountain rainforest. Once you locate your assigned gorilla family, spend a magical hour observing these incredible primates. Optional activities after trekking include a cultural visit or nature walk. Main Destination: Volcanoes National Park Activities: Gorilla Trekking Accommodation: Lodge near Volcanoes National Park Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

days.heading: Day 6: Transfer to Nyungwe Forest National Park
days.body: Travel south through Rwanda's scenic countryside toward Nyungwe Forest National Park. Enjoy views of tea plantations, mountains, and local communities along the way. Arrive at your lodge and relax. Main Destination: Nyungwe Forest National Park Accommodation: Lodge near Nyungwe Forest Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

days.heading: Day 7: Nyungwe Forest Canopy Walk & Optional Chimpanzee Trekking
days.body: Explore one of Africa's oldest rainforests with a guided forest experience. Walk across Rwanda's famous canopy walkway suspended above the forest, offering incredible views of the rainforest ecosystem. Optional chimpanzee trekking can be arranged. Main Destination: Nyungwe Forest National Park Activities: Canopy Walk, Forest Walk, Optional Chimpanzee Trekking Accommodation: Lodge near Nyungwe Forest Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

days.heading: Day 8: Nyungwe Forest to Kigali - Departure
days.body: After breakfast, drive back to Kigali. Depending on your flight schedule, enjoy optional souvenir shopping or additional city activities before transfer to Kigali International Airport. Main Destination: Kigali Meals: Breakfast & Lunch

title: 7-Day Rwanda Holiday Experience - Wildlife Safari, Lake Kivu & Cultural Adventure
overview: Discover the best of Rwanda on this 7-day private holiday package combining wildlife adventures, cultural experiences, scenic landscapes, and relaxing lake escapes. Explore Kigali's history and vibrant culture, enjoy thrilling activities on Mount Kigali, experience a Big Five safari in Akagera National Park, cruise across the beautiful waters of Lake Kivu, and relax at Natural hot springs, and discover Rwanda's peaceful green spaces. This itinerary is designed for travelers who want to experience Rwanda beyond gorilla trekking, offering the perfect combination of adventure, nature, culture, and relaxation.

days.heading: Day 1: Arrival in Kigali - City Tour & Fazenda Adventure Experience
days.body: After breakfast, begin your Kigali city exploration and discover Rwanda's fascinating history from the pre-colonial period, colonial era, post-independence period, and the country's journey of recovery after the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi. Visit the Kigali Genocide Memorial, the final resting place for more than 250,000 victims. The memorial provides an important educational experience about Rwanda's history, remembrance, and reconciliation. After lunch, continue to Fazenda Sengha located on Mount Kigali. This outdoor recreation center offers exciting activities including horseback riding, zip-lining, and quad biking experiences. Return to your hotel for relaxation and overnight stay. Main Destination: Kigali Activities: City Tour, Cultural Visit, Adventure Activities Accommodation: Kigali Marriott Hotel Meals: Lunch & Dinner

days.heading: Day 2: Kigali - Akagera National Park Safari & Lake Ihema Boat Cruise
days.body: After breakfast, depart Kigali for Akagera National Park, located approximately 2.5 hours away. Akagera is Rwanda's largest national park and one of East Africa's most scenic savannah destinations. The park is home to diverse Wildlife including elephants, lions, leopards, buffaloes, rhinos, hippos, giraffes, zebras, antelopes, and hundreds of bird species. Upon arrival, begin your afternoon game drive searching for wildlife while enjoying Akagera's beautiful landscapes of savannah plains, lakes, and wetlands. Later, enjoy a boat cruise on Lake Ihema where you may see hippos, Nile crocodiles, and numerous water birds. Return to your lodge for dinner and overnight. Main Destination: Akagera National Park Activities: Game Drive, Boat Safari Accommodation: Ruzizi Tented Lodge Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

days.heading: Day 3: Full-Day Akagera Safari - Return to Kigali
days.body: Enjoy an early morning game drive through Akagera National Park. Search for the Big Five and other wildlife species while exploring the park's diverse habitats. The park is known for its excellent birding opportunities, including rare species such as the shoebill and Papyrus gonolek. After the safari experience, exit the park and transfer back to Kigali. Main Destination: Kigali Activities: Full-Day Game Drive Accommodation: Kigali Marriott Hotel Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

days.heading: Day 4: Kigali - Kibuye (Lake Kivu) Boat Cruise & Island Exploration
days.body: After breakfast, drive to Kibuye, one of Rwanda's most beautiful lakeside destinations. Lake Kivu is famous for its peaceful atmosphere, scenic islands, clean waters, and spectacular mountain views. Enjoy the beautiful countryside drive through Rwanda's famous rolling hills. In the afternoon, enjoy a boat excursion on Lake Kivu visiting Napoleon Island, famous for its fruit bat colony, and other islands including Amahoro Island, Peace Island, and Monkey Island. Relax and enjoy the peaceful lakeside environment. Main Destination: Kibuye (Karongi) Activities: Scenic Drive, Boat Cruise, Island Visit Accommodation: Cleo Lake Kivu Hotel Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

days.heading: Day 5: Kibuye - Rubavu (Gisenyi) - Boat Cruise, Hot Springs & Return to Kigali
days.body: After breakfast, continue to Rubavu (formerly Gisenyi), a beautiful lakeside town on Lake Kivu known for sandy beaches, warm waters, and a relaxed tropical atmosphere. Enjoy a boat tour on Lake Kivu, offering beautiful views of the surrounding hills and opportunities to visit nearby islands. After lunch, visit Nyamyumba Hot Springs (Amashyuza), a natural attraction known for its warm mineral-rich waters and peaceful surroundings. Enjoy time relaxing before returning to Kigali. Main Destination: Rubavu & Kigali Activities: Boat Cruise, Hot Springs Visit Accommodation: Kigali Marriott Hotel Meals: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

days.heading: Day 7: Departure - Kigali International Airport
days.body: After breakfast, transfer to Kigali International Airport according to your flight departure time.

days.heading: Day 1: Arrival in Kigali - City Tour, Rwanda Art Museum & Art Gallery Experience
days.body: Upon arrival at Kigali International Airport, you will be welcomed by your professional guide and begin your Kigali city exploration. Discover Rwanda's fascinating history, from the pre-colonial period through the colonial era, independence, and the country's recovery after the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi. Your city tour begins with a visit to the Belgian Memorial site, a historical site connected to the events that occurred during the genocide period. Continue to the Kigali Genocide Memorial, the final resting place for more than 250,000 victims. The memorial provides an important educational experience about Rwanda's history and journey toward reconciliation. After lunch, visit the Rwanda Art Museum, formerly the Presidential Palace Museum. The museum showcases contemporary artworks from Rwanda and around the world, highlighting the evolution of Rwandan creativity from traditional expressions to modern artistic forms. You will also see the remains of the presidential aircraft that crashed on 6 April 1994, preserved as part of Rwanda's historical heritage. Later, visit Choose Kigali Art Gallery, a creative space showcasing works from talented Rwandan artists and providing visitors with insight into the country's growing art scene. Transfer to your hotel for overnight stay. title: 2-Days Bigogwe Cultural Experience: Kigali to Kigali

days.heading: Day 1 - Kigali to Bigogwe via Rulindo, Gakenke, and Musanze
days.body: Early Morning - The Drive North and West Leave Kigali by 6:30 AM. The route heads north through Rulindo, then Gakenke, before swinging west through Musanze - Rwanda's gateway to the Virunga volcanoes - and finally south into Nyabihu District toward Bigogwe. This is a longer, more scenic route than heading straight west, taking you through terraced hillsides, small trading towns, and eventually the dramatic volcanic backdrop around Musanze before the landscape softens into Bigogwe's rolling pastures. Expect the full drive to take around 3.5-4 hours depending on stops and road conditions. Mid-Morning - Arrival and Meeting Your Guide you'll arrive at the Ibere rya Bigogwe office, marked by the arch at the Rubavu-Nyabihu border. After a welcome briefing, you're dressed in a shuka or rumbiya - traditional cattle-keeper attire - and given an inkoni, the herding stick every cowherd carries. From here, it's a short trip by moto (or car) into the farms themselves. Late Morning - Among the Green Hills walking into the farmland, the scenery is striking - layered green hills with cattle grazing across them in every direction. Your guide shares the cultural history of Bigogwe, where cows are treated as family, symbols of pride and identity rather than just livestock. You'll join the local cowboys as they herd cattle down to the river for their twice-daily drink, using your inkoni and picking up their traditional whistles and songs along the way. Midday - milking and a Hillside Lunch Back at the farm, you get a hands-on lesson in traditional hand-milking using wooden ibyansi or bamboo ingare containers. After trying it yourself, you're rewarded with the "Bigogwe Cappuccino" - milk fresh and warm straight from the cow. Lunch follows al fresco on the hillside: sweet potatoes, beans, cassava, and more fresh milk. Afternoon - Games, Songs, and Stories The afternoon eases into the rhythms of pastoral life - traditional games the cowboys play while watching over their herds, along with songs and storytelling passed down through generations. Evening - Camping on Bigogwe Hill as the light fades, you pitch camp directly on the farmland. Dinner is a traditional shared meal, and once night falls fully, the stargazing here is exceptional - no city lights for miles. ________________________________________

days.heading: Day 2 - Hiking Ibere rya Bigogwe Rock and the Return via Musanze, Gakenke, and Rulindo
days.body: Early Morning - waking in the Highlands Sunrise is cool and misty. Breakfast is traditional, paired again with fresh milk. Morning - Second Milking Round and Ghee-Making A second milking session for those who want more practice, followed by a demonstration of traditional ghee-making - watching or helping as fresh milk becomes clarified butter the traditional way. Mid-Morning - The Climb to Ibere rya Bigogwe Rock a guided hike up the landmark rock formation that gives the area its name. Along the way, your guide points out local plants and their traditional uses. The climb is moderate, and the summit rewards you with sweeping views over the surrounding farmland and hills. Midday - Farewell Back at the farm, you break camp and share a final traditional meal with the community before saying goodbye to your hosts. Afternoon - the Journey Back Depart Bigogwe by early afternoon, retracing the route back through Musanze, Gakenke, and Rulindo to Kigali. Arrive back in the capital by early-to-mid evening.

title: 6-Day Congo Nile Trail: Kigali Pickup to Kigali Drop-off (only 4 days for activities other 2 are transfer and drop off)

days.heading: Day 1 - Pickup and Transfer to Rubavu
days.body: Morning - Pickup in Kigali Your guide picks you up from your Kigali hotel in the morning, typically around 8:00-9:00 AM. After a short briefing on the days ahead - what to pack, pacing, and what to expect from the trail - you set off northwest toward Lake Kivu. Midday - The Drive to Rubavu The drive takes roughly 4.5 hours, descending through green hills toward the lake. Depending on timing, this can include a brief stop in Kigali itself (genocide memorial, local market) or run straight through, arriving in Rubavu by early afternoon. Afternoon - Settling In Check into your hotel in Rubavu (Gisenyi) and use the rest of the day to rest and acclimatize. A walk along Gisenyi's lakeside promenade in the late afternoon is a good way to get your first proper look at Lake Kivu - Rwanda's largest lake, sitting at over 1,460 meters above sea level, ringed by hills on all sides. Evening - Final Preparations Dinner at your hotel, with a final gear check and a clearer briefing on tomorrow's first trail stage. Rest early - the real walking starts in the morning.

days.heading: Day 2 - Rubavu to Cyimbiri: Onto the Trail
days.body: Morning - Trailhead Briefing Meet your guide at Bralirwa, Rwanda's oldest brewery and the official starting point of the Congo Nile Trail. A short orientation covers the terrain ahead before you set off on foot. Midday to Evening - The First Stage This is a full day of hiking, roughly 7 hours, through a landscape shaped by generations of farming - coffee, cassava, beans, and banana plantations layered across rolling hills. Lake Kivu reappears constantly below as the trail climbs and descends, giving you your first real sense of the trail's rhythm: steady effort, constant reward. Overnight in Cyimbiri Arrive at Cyimbiri village in the early evening and settle into a simple budget guesthouse, tired but immersed in the pace of rural life along the lake.

days.heading: Day 3 - Cyimbiri to Kinunu: Coffee and Lakeshore Life
days.body: Morning - Second Trail Stage After breakfast, set out on a roughly 5-hour hike to Kinunu. The terrain eases slightly compared to Day 2, giving you more space to take in the surroundings - dense coffee and banana plantations, and some of the best birdwatching stretches on the trail. Afternoon - Coffee Washing Station and Village Life Stop at a local coffee washing station to see how Rwandan coffee cherries are processed before drying, a hands-on look at an industry that shapes much of this region's economy. Continue into Kinunu's lakeside villages, where you can talk with local fishing and farming families going about their day. Overnight in Kinunu Settle into a lakeside guesthouse as the sun sets over the water - one of the trail's most peaceful stops.

days.heading: Day 4 - Kinunu to Karongi, and Islands on Lake Kivu
days.body: Morning - Final Hiking Stage Set out after breakfast for the last trekking leg, continuing through rolling hills and terraced farmland toward Karongi (Kibuye). By now the walking feels familiar, more about soaking in the cumulative scenery than pushing through new ground. Afternoon - Boat Trip to the Islands Arrive in Karongi around midday and swap hiking boots for a boat seat. Visit Napoleon Island, shaped like Napoleon's hat and home to a large bat colony reachable by a short climb, then Monkey Island, where vervet monkeys move freely through the trees, and finally the quieter Peace Island for a slower, reflective stop by the water. Overnight in Karongi Check into a hotel in Karongi town - a comfortable step up after two nights in trailside guesthouses.

days.heading: Day 5 - Mount Karongi, Sorghum Beer, and the Environmental Museum
days.body: Morning - Up Mount Karongi A 4×4 takes you up a rough but scenic road to the summit of Mount Karongi, one of the region's highest peaks, about an hour from town. The views from the top rank among the best of the trip - Lake Kivu spread out below, framed by every hill you've walked through over the past three days. Mid-Morning - Sorghum Beer Experience Near the summit, meet the Dushyigikirane sorghum farmers for a full walkthrough of traditional sorghum beer-making, from harvest to the finished brew, shared the traditional way from a communal calabash - an unhurried, genuine cultural exchange. Midday - Environmental Museum Back in Karongi, visit Africa's only Environmental Museum, with exhibits on Lake Kivu's ecosystem and the conservation challenges facing the region. Afternoon - Rest and Reflection The afternoon is left open - relax by the lake, wander Karongi town, or simply rest ahead of the return journey. This is your last night on the trail, so it's worth spending it slowly. Overnight in Karongi

days.heading: Day 6 - Drop-off: Karongi to Kigali
days.body: Morning - Final Breakfast A relaxed final breakfast in Karongi, with time to pack and reflect on the past five days before heading back. Midday - The Drive Back to Kigali Depart Karongi around midday for the roughly 3-hour drive back to Kigali, retracing the route along Lake Kivu's shore in the opposite direction. Afternoon - Drop-off in Kigali Arrive back in Kigali by mid-to-late afternoon, where your guide drops you at your hotel or another agreed location - closing out a six-day journey that took you from lakeside brewery to mountaintop sorghum farm and back. Practical notes: Distance and pace: Covers the Rubavu-Karongi section (~60km) of the 227km full trail, spread over three moderate hiking days (Days 2-4) with lighter cultural and rest days bookending the trek. Fitness level: Moderate to challenging on hiking days - rolling and sometimes steep terrain; vehicle support is typically available if needed. Accommodation: Hotel in Rubavu (Night 1), budget guesthouses in Cyimbiri and Kinunu (Nights 2-3), hotel in Karongi (Nights 4-5). Best season: June-September (dry season) for firmer trail conditions; some river crossings become difficult during rains. Alternative: The trekking days can be swapped for mountain biking for those who prefer cycling to walking.

Akagera National Park is home to the Big Five, with the recent reintroduction of lions. It is the only savanna park in Rwanda and hosts a diverse range of mammal species, including lions, elephants, giraffes, hippos, kobs, zebras, and bushbucks. Most recently, black rhinos were introduced from South Africa, restoring Akagera’s status as a Big Five park, just as it was many years ago

Experience adventure redefined, immerse yourself in the wonders of Rwanda, all in the lap of luxury

title: 10 Days Rwanda Educational Tour
overview: This 10 days Rwanda Educational Tour delivers a high-impact learning journey through Rwanda’s most compelling landscapes and cultural environments. The program equips participants with in-depth knowledge of Rwanda’s cultural heritage, reconciliation process, conservation efforts, and rich biodiversity, including flora and fauna. Designed for travelers seeking both flexibility and authenticity, the itinerary integrates education, culture, and nature to ensure a well-balanced and enriching experience. Traveling at a comfortable pace, participants benefit from scenic drives, diverse wildlife encounters, tranquil lakeside experiences, and purposeful community and educational engagements. Moreover, these engagements provide meaningful insight into Rwanda’s past, present, and future. Overall, this 10 Days Rwanda Educational Tour is an ideal platform for experiential learning, cultural understanding, and sustainable travel outcomes
facts:
Tour Name: 10 Days Rwanda Educational Tour
Duration: 10 days
Countries: Rwanda
Itinerary: 10 day-by-day sections
Price: From $6,000 /person (2 pax)

days.heading: Day 1: Arrival Kigali and transfer to the hotel
days.body: Upon arrival at Kigali International Airport, you will proceed through customs and immigration. Then, our company guide will warmly welcome you to the “Land of a Thousand Hills,” as Rwanda is affectionately known. Afterward, you will be transferred to your reserved hotel accommodation. Here, you can unwind, enjoy a delicious dinner, and settle in for an overnight stay. Midrange Accommodation: Mille Collines Hotel Meals: Breakfast, lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 2
days.body:
Visit Ntarama Genocide Memorial, Reconciliation Village and Kigali genocide memorial centre

After breakfast, embark on a reflective journey through Rwanda’s history with visits to the Ntarama and Nyamata Genocide Memorials. Here, you will gain profound insight into the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi and the nation’s resilience. Next, visit a Reconciliation Village, where survivors and former perpetrators live together in harmony. This symbolizes Rwanda’s inspiring path toward healing and unity. Later, return to Kigali for lunch at a local restaurant. Then, continue your journey with a visit to Kigali Genocide memorial centre and a trip to the lively Kimironko Local Market. Here, you can observe local vendors and colourful displays of Rwandan life. Finally, in the evening, return to your lodge for dinner and reflection. Midrange Accommodation: Mille Collines Hotel Meals: Breakfast, lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 3
days.body:
Transfer to Huye with a visit to Azizi Life, Kings Palace museum and Huye Ethnographic museum

After breakfast, transfer to Nyanza. Enroute, visit Azizi Life Center, where you can join locals in their hillside community and take part in daily artisan activities. There, you can learn traditional cooking, enjoy interaction and feasting, and have lunch in the village. Later, continue to Nyanza to visit the King’s Palace Museum. This cultural landmark introduces traditional Rwandan kingship and the country’s heritage. Then, proceed to Huye to explore the Ethnographic Museum, a treasure of historical artifacts and colonial-era architecture. In the afternoon, visit the iconic Catholic Church in Butare. Overall, this day provides a deep dive into Rwanda’s history, traditions, and architecture. Midrange accommodation: Mater Boni Consilii Hotel Meals: Breakfast, lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 4: Visit to Kitabi Conservation College and canopy walk in the afternoon
days.body: The day combines education and soft adventure. First, begin with a guided visit to Kitabi Conservation College to learn about Rwanda’s conservation efforts, climate resilience, and sustainable natural resource management. In the afternoon, experience the iconic canopy walk in Nyungwe Forest National Park. Here, enjoy elevated views over the ancient rainforest and observe wildlife, birds, and rich vegetation. Afterwards, return to your lodge for a relaxed evening. Midrange Accommodation: Mantis Kivu Marina Bay Meals: Breakfast, lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 5: Chimpanzee trek and afternoon tea plantation experience
days.body: Start your day early at 5:00am with breakfast. Then, head to Nyungwe National Park for an exhilarating chimpanzee trek. After a briefing at the park headquarters, embark on a guided trek through the rainforest. Here, observe playful chimpanzees in their natural habitat. In the afternoon, visit a local tea plantation at Gisakura. There, witness the harvesting and processing of Rwanda’s renowned teas. Additionally, engage with local communities and enjoy tasting sessions. Finally, return to your lodge for dinner and overnight stay. Midrange Accommodation: Mantis Kivu Marina Bay Meals: Breakfast, lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 6
days.body:
Transfer to Volcanoes with a visit to the Museum of Environment in Karongi, Boat trip and coffee tour

First, enjoy a scenic transfer to Volcanoes National Park via Karongi, including a visit to the Museum of Environment. Here, you will gain insight into Rwanda’s conservation and sustainability initiatives. Then, enjoy a relaxing boat trip on Lake Kivu. Afterwards, take a guided coffee plantation tour highlighting sustainable production and local livelihoods. Finally, continue to Volcanoes National Park, where you will arrive in the evening for lodge check in and rest ahead of the next day’s primate activities. Midrange Accommodation: Tiloreza Volcano Eco Lodge Meals: Breakfast, lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 7: Gorilla Trekking and Ibyiwacu cultural village visit
days.body: In the morning, after breakfast, head to the Volcanoes National Park office in Ruhengeri. Upon arrival at the park headquarters, you will receive a briefing on the rules to follow and not follow while enjoying park tea. Then, transfer to the starting point of your gorilla trekking safari. Gorilla trekking in Volcanoes National Park can last more than 3 hours. Once you find them, spend an hour observing them play and feed their young. Afterwards, return to the hotel for lunch. Later, visit Ibyiwacu cultural village to experience the unique culture of Rwandans. Midrange Accommodation: Tiloreza Volcano Eco Lodge Meals: Breakfast, lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 8: Golden monkey trekking and transfer to Akagera NP
days.body: The day begins with Golden Monkey trekking in Volcanoes National Park, where a guided hike through the bamboo forest provides an exceptional opportunity to observe these lively primates in their natural habitat. After this rewarding jungle experience, return to the lodge for lunch. Then, depart for Akagera National Park, located in eastern Rwanda and renowned for its classic savannah landscapes. Here, Akagera is home to the Big Five and offers outstanding wildlife experiences, including game drives and scenic boat safaris. Midrange Accommodation: Mantis Akagera Game Lodge Meals: Breakfast, lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 9: Full Game Drive in Akagera National Park and transfer back to Kigali
days.body: Start the day with an early morning game drive, delving into the vast and diverse landscapes of Akagera National Park. Here, the park is home to an impressive range of wildlife, including elephants, giraffes, lions, and the elusive Big Five. Next, explore its grasslands and woodlands, encountering over 12 antelope species, such as the majestic eland, roan antelope, and topi. Additionally, Akagera is a haven for bird enthusiasts, with over 525 bird species, including the rare Albertine Rift endemics. Along the way, marvel at the park’s scenic beauty, spot reptiles and amphibians, and immerse yourself in its extraordinary biodiversity. Afterwards, transfer back to Kigali, arriving in the early evening. Then, check in to your booked hotel to freshen up, followed by a specially organized farewell dinner for the group, providing a relaxed and meaningful conclusion to your journey. Midrange Accommodation: Mantis Akagera Game Lodge Meals: Breakfast, lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 10: Boat trip and airport departure
days.body: First, enjoy a scenic boat trip on Lake Ihema, located within Akagera National Park. This relaxing excursion offers excellent opportunities to observe aquatic wildlife, including hippos and crocodiles, as well as a wide variety of bird species along the shoreline. Afterwards, proceed with a timely transfer to Kigali International Airport for your outbound flight, concluding the day with smooth, efficient, and well-coordinated departure arrangements, marking the10 Days Rwanda Educational Tour. Meals: Breakfast and lunchTour

Today, after your relaxed morning breakfast, you will check out from the lodge and begin the scenic drive to Volcanoes National Park. Upon arrival, you will visit the Ellen DeGeneres Campus of the Dian Fossey Gorilla Fund, where you will gain valuable insight into the conservation initiatives, scientific research, and ongoing efforts dedicated to protecting and habituating the mountain gorillas. After this enriching experience, you will proceed to your hotel. The rest of the afternoon will be at your leisure an ideal time to relax and prepare for the following day’s thrilling gorilla trekking adventure

days.heading: Day 9: Gorilla Trekking at Volcanoes National Park
days.body:
After an early morning breakfast, you will be transferred to the park headquarters. You will meet with your ranger who will brief you about the code of conduct while are trekking gorillas. You will then enter the forest in search of the gorillas. The trekking may take 2-6 hours depending on the movement of the gorillas in the jungle and your group speed as well. Meet and stay with the gorillas for a maximum of one hour. After an unforgettable experience, you will walk back to the starting point, where you will be transferred to your lodge for lunch. Following lunch, you may choose to relax at the lodge at your leisure or opt for a cultural encounter at the Iby’Iwacu Cultural Village to gain insight into Rwandan culture. Dinner and an overnight stay will be at your hotel

days.body:

You will then begin your golden monkey trekking experience, venturing into the forest in search of these playful and shy primates. The activity follows a similar structure to gorilla trekking, though it is generally less strenuous, offering an enjoyable and engaging wildlife encounter. After the trek, you will return to the lodge for lunch and a refreshing shower. Once ready, you will proceed with the transfer back to the airport to check in for your departure flight, marking the conclusion of your memorable adventure

title: 4 Days Murchison Falls Safari
overview: This 4 Day Murchison Falls Safari is designed to immerse you in the breathtaking beauty of Uganda’s largest national park. You will have the opportunity to witness the awe-inspiring Murchison Falls, encounter a wide array of wildlife species, and participate in thrilling activities within the park. Whether you are traveling with a large group or a small party, this safari offers an affordable and unforgettable adventure
facts:
Tour Name: 4 Days Murchison Falls Safari
Duration: 4 days
Countries: Uganda
Itinerary: 4 day-by-day sections
Price: From $1,564 /person (2 pax)

days.heading: Day 1: Kampala to Murchison Falls National Park
days.body:
Your day begins with an early breakfast. By 8:30 am, our guide will pick you up from your hotel in Kampala, Entebbe, or another location. We will embark on a journey filled with lasting memories as we make our way to Murchison Falls National Park. Along the way, you will have the chance to interact with locals at market centers, where you can purchase fresh produce such as oranges, mangoes, pineapples, maize, and yellow bananas

Our first stop is in Luwero District, where you can opt for a rhino trekking experience at Ziwa Rhino Sanctuary, a must-do activity that brings you up close to these magnificent creatures grazing in their natural habitat. Afterward, we will continue to Murchison Falls National Park. Upon arrival, you will hike to the top of the falls, where you can take in the stunning scenery, feel the powerful wind, and capture unforgettable moments with photos. After the hike, we will head to your accommodation. Dinner and overnight at your lodge

Accommodation options

• Standard: Ikorom Safari Lodge

• Midrange: Pakuba Safari Lodge

• Luxury: Paraa Safari lodge

days.heading: Day 2: Murchison Falls Game Drive
days.body:
Start your day early with a choice between breakfast at the lodge or after the game drive. We will then set out on a remarkable game drive through the park, where you will have the chance to see the iconic Big Five: leopards, lions, cheetahs, giraffes, elephants, and buffaloes. You will also spot other wildlife, including zebras, Uganda kobs, antelopes, warthogs, baboons, and monkeys

After an exhilarating 4-hour game drive, we will return to the lodge for breakfast or lunch, depending on the timing. In the afternoon, your guide will take you to the landing site for a boat cruise. This relaxing cruise on the Nile offers stunning views of animals such as hippos, shoebills, elephants, and buffaloes along the riverbanks. Depending on your preference, you may hike to the top of the falls after the boat cruise for a more adventurous experience. Afterward, return to the lodge to unwind before dinner

Accommodation options

• Standard: Ikorom Safari Lodge

• Midrange: Pakuba Safari Lodge

• Luxury: Paraa Safari lodge

days.heading: Day 3: Chimpanzee Trekking: Budongo Forest
days.body:
After an early breakfast, we will pack a lunch and set out for Budongo Forest, where you will report to the Uganda Wildlife Authority (UWA) offices. Here, you will be grouped and assigned a chimpanzee ranger, who will guide you through the forest during your trek. The trek may last 5 to 6 hours, with up to an hour spent observing the chimpanzees if permitted by your ranger. After the trek, you’ll return to the starting point, where your driver/guide will be waiting to take you back to the lodge. Relax and prepare for the next day’s journey back to Kampala

Accommodation options

• Standard: Ikorom Safari Lodge

• Midrange: Pakuba Safari Lodge

• Luxury: Paraa Safari lodge

days.heading: Day 4: Travel Back to Kampala
days.body: Enjoy an early breakfast before starting your journey back to Kampala. We will take a short game drive as we head to the ferry crossing. Lunch will be provided en route, either in Masindi or Luwero, depending on the time. Once we arrive in Kampala, you can decide whether you would like to be dropped off at the airport, or your hotel, or enjoy a city tour if time permits

overview:

Known for its stunning landscapes and abundant wildlife, the Maasai Mara offers an unforgettable experience in the heart of Africa’s wilderness. On the first day, you will travel from Nairobi to the reserve, immersing yourself in the beauty of the Kenyan countryside. The following day is dedicated to exploring the Maasai Mara through thrilling game drives, providing ample opportunities to encounter the Big Five and other iconic wildlife in their natural habitat. Your adventure concludes on the third day with a final game drive before returning to Nairobi, leaving you with lasting memories of your time in one of the world’s most celebrated wildlife reserves

This short but intense safari promises a deep connection with nature and a glimpse into the wild wonders of Kenya
facts:
Tour Name: 3 Days Maasai Mara Big 5 Safari
Duration: 3 days
Countries: Kenya
Itinerary: 3 day-by-day sections
Price: From $1,510 /person (2 pax)

days.heading: Day 1: Nairobi to Maasai Mara (Approx. 265 km: 5 hours)
days.body:
A morning departure from Nairobi to start 3 Days Maasai Mara Big 5 Safari, enjoy a scenic drive through the Great Rift Valley en route to Maasai Mara. Upon arrival, check in at your lodge/camp and have lunch. Relax and prepare for the afternoon game drive. Embark on your first game drive in Maasai Mara, exploring the vast savannah and spotting Big Five wildlife, Explore the vast savannah as you search for the Big Five, lions, elephants, buffaloes, leopards, and rhinos, in their natural habitat. Return to the lodge for dinner and an evening of relaxation

Accommodation options

• Standard: Basecamp Adventure

• Midrange: Zebra Plains Mara Camp

• Luxury: Entim Mara Camp

days.heading: Day 2: Full Day in Maasai Mara
days.body:
After an early breakfast, you will set out on a sunrise game drive. The early hours are ideal for spotting wildlife as they are most active during this time. The golden light of dawn enhances the landscape’s beauty and offers excellent photography opportunities

Return to your lodge for a leisurely lunch or leave the lodge with a packed lunch. After lunch, embark on an afternoon game drive continuing your exploration of the Maasai Mara. This drive offers another chance to encounter the Big Five, lions, elephants, buffaloes, leopards, and rhinos, as well as other iconic animals like giraffes, zebras, and wildebeests. After the game drive, you will return to the lodge for dinner. Spend the evening in tranquility, reflecting on the day’s adventures, and enjoy the serene atmosphere of the African bush

Accommodation options

• Standard: Basecamp Adventure

• Midrange: Zebra Plains Mara Camp

• Luxury: Entim Mara Camp

days.heading: Day 3: Maasai Mara to Nairobi (Approx. 265 km: 5 hours)
days.body:
After breakfast, embark on a one-final game drive in the cool morning hours as you make your way out of the park. This last drive offers a final opportunity to spot wildlife in the tranquil morning light. As you journey back to Nairobi you will enjoy the scenic views along the way. Arrive in Nairobi in the early afternoon, bringing your unforgettable 3 Days Maasai Mara Big 5 Safari

Meal

title: 4 Days Lake Nakuru and Maasai Mara
overview: Embark on an unforgettable 4-day safari adventure that will take you deep into the heart of Kenya’s most iconic wildlife destinations. This journey will immerse you in the stunning landscapes and vibrant ecosystems of Lake Nakuru and the Maasai Mara, offering a perfect bldrives, thrilling game viewing, and comfortable accommodations. This carefully crafted itinerary promises to deliver an authentic and thrilling African safari, offering you an intimate connection with nature and an unforgettable journey through some of Kenya’s most treasured natural wonders
facts:
Tour Name: 4 Days Lake Nakuru and Maasai Mara
Duration: 4 days
Countries: Kenya
Itinerary: 4 day-by-day sections
Price: From $1,910 /person (2 pax)

days.heading: Day 1: Nairobi to Lake Nakuru
days.body:
Your adventure begins with a morning departure from Nairobi, where you will embark on a scenic drive through the Great Rift Valley, a geological wonder characterized by steep escarpments and verdant landscapes. Along the way, you will pass through local villages and rolling hills, with opportunities to stop for panoramic views and photos. Upon arrival at Lake Nakuru National Park, you will check into your lodge and take a brief rest before setting out on your first game drive. Lake Nakuru is renowned for its stunning birdlife, including vast flocks of flamingos that often line the lake’s edge, creating a mesmerizing pink hue. The park is also home to rhinos, both black and white, as well as giraffes, buffaloes, and the elusive leopard. As the sun sets, casting a golden glow over the acacia trees, you will return to your lodge for a relaxing evening. Overnight at the lodge on a Full Board basis

Accommodation options

• Standard: Lake Nakuru Lodge

• Midrange: Lake Nakuru Sopa Lodge

• Luxury: The Cliff Nakuru

days.heading: Day 2: Lake Nakuru to Maasai Mara
days.body:
After breakfast, you will depart Lake Nakuru and drive towards the world-famous Maasai Mara National Reserve, passing through the heart of Kenya’s scenic countryside. The drive offers glimpses of rural life, with opportunities to see local Maasai communities and their traditional way of life. As you approach the Maasai Mara, the landscape changes to vast savannahs dotted with acacia trees, signaling the beginning of a thrilling safari experience. Upon arrival, you will check into your camp and enjoy lunch before heading out for an afternoon game drive. The Maasai Mara is teeming with wildlife, including the Big Five, lion, elephant, buffalo, leopard, and rhino, as well as cheetahs, hyenas, and countless herbivores. Your first game drive in the Mara will introduce you to the area’s incredible biodiversity and stunning landscapes. After a day of exploration, return to your camp for a cozy evening under the stars. Overnight at the camp on a Full Board basis

Accommodation options

• Standard: Basecamp Adventure

• Midrange: Zebra Plains Mara Camp

• Luxury: Entim Mara Camp

days.heading: Day 3: Maasai Mara: Full Day Game Drives
days.body:
This day is dedicated to an immersive safari experience in the Maasai Mara, with morning and afternoon game drives that will take you deep into the heart of the reserve. You will have the opportunity to witness the magnificent Great Migration (seasonal), where millions of wildebeest, zebras, and gazelles traverse the plains in search of greener pastures, often closely followed by predators. The Mara River, a key crossing point, is a dramatic sight where crocodiles lie in wait for the migrating herds. Even outside of migration season, the Maasai Mara offers extraordinary wildlife encounters, with a pride of lions lounging in the grass, elephants ambling across the plains, and herds of antelope grazing peacefully. Between game drives, you will return to camp for lunch and enjoy leisure time, or enjoy a siesta, or a walk around the camp’s surroundings. In the evening, as the sun sets and the sky turns a fiery orange, your final game drive of the day will offer stunning photo opportunities. Overnight at the camp on a Full Board basis

Accommodation options

• Standard: Basecamp Adventure

• Midrange: Zebra Plains Mara Camp

• Luxury: Entim Mara Camp

days.heading: Day 4: Maasai Mara to Nairobi
days.body:
The day will start with an early morning drive, where you can catch the last glimpses of how the Mara’s wildlife start their day. After the drive, you will return to the camp for breakfast. With memories of incredible wildlife encounters and stunning landscapes, you will begin your journey back to Nairobi. The drive takes you once again through the picturesque Kenyan countryside, arriving in Nairobi in the late afternoon. Depending on your flight schedule, you may have time for some last-minute shopping or a visit to a local market before heading to the airport for your departure

Meal

overview: This 4 Days Kenya Wildlife Safari takes you through the great rift valley and guarantees you sightings of vast animal species. Visit Kenya with us and have a memorable safari

Depart in our 4 x 4 safari micro van to Lake Nakuru National Park. You will have a short stop at the Great Rift Valley view point to take photos of this geographical phenomenon stretching from Lebanon to Mozambique covering about 9,000 Kilometres. Check in then lunch at your lodge. Afternoon game drive from 1600 hrs with opportunity to see Lake Nakuru, the alkaline lake that hosts several bird species and plenty of animal species like Buffalos, White Rhinos, Water Bucks, Lions and Rothschild Giraffes among others. Dinner and overnight stay at your lodge / tented camp. Meals: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner

title: 7 Days Amboseli Great Rift and Big 5 Safari
overview: Embark on a journey through Kenya’s most iconic landscapes with our 7 Days Amboseli, Great Rift, and Big 5 Safari. Your adventure begins in the shadow of Africa’s highest mountain, Mount Kilimanjaro, where Amboseli National Park offers unparalleled opportunities to witness large herds of elephants and other wildlife against the backdrop of the majestic snow-capped peak. The journey then takes you to the tranquil waters of Lake Naivasha, nestled in the heart of the Great Rift Valley, where you will explore the lake’s rich birdlife and enjoy a unique boat safari. The safari culminates in the world-renowned Maasai Mara National Reserve, home to the Big Five, lion, elephant, buffalo, rhino, and leopard, and the stage for one of nature’s most spectacular events, the Great Migration

days.heading: Day 2: Nairobi / Amboseli National Park
days.body: Breakfast will be served from 0630 hrs. Check out and meet your safari driver guide at 0730 hrs. Board your vehicle and embark on a south easterly journey towards Amboseli National Park. Arrival at your lodge for check in then lunch. Afternoon game drives in Amboseli, the land of the “Salty Masai Dust” from 1600 to 1800 hrs. days.heading: Day 3: Amboseli National Park
days.body: Morning game drives at 0630 hrs and 1600 hrs respectively with the rest of the day relaxing at your lodge or enjoying a swim. There is also an optional for a near full day game drive with packed lunch. Located at the foot hill of Mt. Kilimanjaro, Amboseli enjoys stunning views of Mt. Kilimanjaro with good weather and clear skies and has several lakes and swamps that attract several wildlife and bird species. Lions, Hippos, Cheetahs, black backed Jackals, Zebras, and several bird species including the Kori Bustard (the heaviest flying bird) At the foot of Africa’s highest mountain, Kilimanjaro, it is one of Kenya’s most popular national parks, located very close to the Tanzania border. The snow-capped peak of Mount Kilimanjaro rising above the clouds dominates every aspect of Amboseli. Established as a national park in 1974 it covers 150sq miles and supports a wide range of mammals (well over 50 of the larger species) and birds (over 400 species). Years ago, this was the locale around which such famous writers as Ernest Hemingway and Robert Ruark spun their stories of big game hunting in the wilds of Africa. The park encompasses dry lake beds, savannah woodland and extensive swamps constantly fed by springs emanating from the mountain. The water and seasonal lakes attract a wide variety of bird and animal life, in particular herds of elephant. Amboseli is one of the best parks in Africa to observe family groups of elephants and large bull elephants at close quarters. All meals and overnight stay at your lodge

days.heading: Day 4: Amboseli / Aberdare National Park
days.body: Breakfast will be served from 0630 hrs. Check out by 0730 hrs and depart for Aberdare National Park, located in the lush central Kenya highlights on a scenic drive via Nairobi. Lunch will be provided en route. Arrival at your base hotel for your Tree Lodge and check in. You will then enjoy a special shuttle transfer deep into Aberdare National Park where your tree lodge for tonight is located. This evening and night, game viewing will be from the comfort of a special raised bunker as you watch animals visit the lodge’s flood – lit water hole and salt lick. Dinner and overnight stay at your lodge

days.heading: Day 5: Aberdare / Ol Pejeta Wildlife Conservancy
days.body: You will be transferred back to your base hotel after breakfast. Check out by 1000 hrs and drive to the nearby Ol Pejeta Wildlife Conservancy. Check in at Serena Sweetwaters Camp followed by lunch from 1230 hrs. You will then enjoy game drives in the vast Ol Pejeta conservancy. Ol Pejeta, which is a private game rich conservancy, holds some of the highest predator densities in Kenya. The Conservancy, which is host to all the members of the ‘Big Five’ (elephant, rhino, lion, buffalo and leopard), has a higher wildlife-to-area ratio than any Kenyan national park and is one of only four private game conservancies to have been founded in Kenya. At the forefront of the Kenyan conservancy program, the conservancy boasts the largest black rhino sanctuary in East Africa including “Baraka” the male, blind black rhino, hosts the only chimpanzee sanctuary in Kenya, and shelters large numbers of rare and endangered species. Dinner and overnight at Serena Sweetwater’s Tented Camp

days.heading: Day 6: Ol Pejeta / Lake Nakuru National Park
days.body: Breakfast will be served. Check out by 0800 hrs and embark on a south westerly drive, skirting the Aberdare Mountain ranges and driving down the floor of the Great Rift Valley towards Lake Nakuru National Park with a short stop over at the Stunning Nyahururu (Thompson Falls). Check in followed by lunch at your lodge. You will enjoy an afternoon game drive on the shores of the Alkaline Lake Nakuru as well as around the park. This will give you opportunities to spot Buffaloes, Rhinos, Rothschild Giraffes, Baboons, Spotted Hyenas, Leopards, Lions, Water Bucks, Elands, Pelicans, Egyptian Goose among several others, and if lucky, the lesser Flamingos that this park is world famous for until 1800 hrs. Dinner and overnight stay at Lake Nakuru Lodge / Similar

days.heading: Day 7: Lake Nakuru / Maasai Mara National Reserve
days.body: Breakfast will be served. Check out by 0730 hrs and drive to Maasai Mara. Check in followed by lunch at your lodge. Afternoon game drive from 1600 hrs, the beginning of the amazing Maasai Mara game viewing experience. Dinner and overnight stay at your lodge

days.heading: Day 8: Maasai Mara
days.body: Early morning and late afternoon game drives in search of the BIG 5; Lion, Buffalo, Elephant, Rhino, and Leopard and several other animals including Impalas, Gazelles, Wildebeests, Hyenas, Topis, Zebras, Giraffes and hundreds of bird species. Being a southern extension of Tanzania’s Serengeti**,** the annual Wildebeests Migration from Serengeti to Maasai Mara also takes place here between July and October when millions of Wildebeests and Zebras closely trailed by the Big Cats cross the Mara River and roam the reserve’s plains in search of greener pastures. Rest of the time at leisure in your lodge.All meals and overnight stay at your lodge

days.body: After early breakfast, check out and with packed lunches descend the down walls of the world’s largest caldera for a half day of game and sightseeing on the crater floor. A UNESCO World Heritage Site, the crater has global importance for biodiversity conservation due to the presence of globally threatened species, the density of wildlife inhabiting the area, and the annual migration of wildebeest, zebra, gazelles and other animals into the northern plains. Extensive archaeological research has also yielded a long sequence of evidence of human evolution and human-environment dynamics, including early hominid footprints dating back 3.6 million years. Here you have a chance to spot Lions, Elephants, Buffalos, Hippos, Cheetahs, Hyenas and several antelope and birds species. You will depart for Serengeti National Park in the afternoon and enjoy en route game viewing. Dinner and overnight stay at your lodge

days.heading: Day 3: Serengeti National Park
days.body: Early morning and late afternoon game drives in the vast park. Serengeti derived from the name “Siringet” which means endless plains in Masai Language hosts the Great Plains where the endless streams of wildebeest and zebra pour south towards Ngorongoro or north towards the Maasai Mara during their annual migration. The park is home to the BIG 5 and other species including Hyenas, Cheetahs, Caracals, Serval Cats and several bovine species. It is also home to hundreds of bird species including vultures. Our game drives will cover the varied habitats and eco-systems of Serengeti. All meals and overnight stay at your lodge/ tented camp

days.heading: Day 4: Serengeti /Lake Manyara National Park
days.body: Breakfast will be served. At 0730 hrs, depart for Lake Manyara National Park via the Ngorongoro highlands. Check in, and then lunch at your lodge. You will enjoy an afternoon game drive at the nearby Lake Manyara National Park until 1800 hrs. Lake Manyara National Park is situated spectacularly between the Great Rift Valley Escarpment and Lake Manyara. The most famous spectacle is the tree-climbing lions, which are occasionally seen along branches of Acacia trees. Lake Manyara National Park is also known for the flamingos that inhabit the lake. During the wet season they inhabit the edges of the lake in flocks of thousands but they are not so present during the dry season. More than 400 species of birds inhabit the park and many remain throughout the year. Dinner and overnight stay at your lodge

days.heading: Day 5: Lake Manyara / Arusha / Depart
days.body: After breakfast, check out and drive back to Arusha where optional lunch will be served at a restaurant followed by optional transfer to either the Kilimanjaro International Airport or Namanga border.Nights 5 Days Northern Tanzania Wildlife Tour

Your adventure continues into the vast Serengeti, renowned for exceptional game drives, Big Five sightings, and the spectacle of the Great Wildebeest Migration. You will also visit Lake Manyara National Park, home to the rare tree climbing lions. To enrich your cultural immersion, the program includes a visit to a Maasai Boma, offering an authentic insight into the traditional lifestyle of the Maasai people

title: 10 Days Uganda Gorilla Trekking & Maasai Mara Migration Adventure
overview: This 10 Days Uganda Gorilla Trekking and Maasai Mara Migration Adventure offers an unforgettable wildlife journey across East Africa. The experience begins with gorilla trekking in the thick forests of Bwindi Impenetrable National Park in Uganda, one of the most remarkable places in the world to observe mountain gorillas. In fact, Bwindi protects nearly half of the world’s remaining mountain gorilla population. In addition, the safari introduces you to local culture and beautiful countryside landscapes as you travel through Rwanda and Uganda. During the journey, you can visit the Kigali Genocide Memorial Centre and later explore the peaceful waters of Lake Bunyonyi during a canoe experience. After your gorilla adventure, you will fly to Kenya to continue your wildlife safari. Here, you will search for the Big Five in Lake Nakuru National Park before continuing to the famous Maasai Mara National Reserve. The Mara offers excellent opportunities to see big cats, large herds of wildlife, and abundant bird species. Most importantly, this safari allows you to witness the spectacular Great Wildebeest Migration, one of the greatest wildlife events on Earth
facts:
Tour Name: 10 Days Uganda Gorilla Trekking & Maasai Mara Migration Adventure
Duration: 10 days
Countries: Rwanda, Uganda, Kenya
Itinerary: 9 day-by-day sections
Price: From $6,389 /person (2 pax)

days.heading: Day 1: Transfer from the airport to the hotel
days.body: Upon arrival at Kigali International Airport, you will pass through immigration before meeting our professional safari driver. He will welcome you, briefly introduce the safari, and then transfer you to your hotel for dinner and an overnight stay. This marks the beginning of your 10 Days Uganda Gorilla Trekking and Maasai Mara Migration Adventure. Accommodation: Chez Lando Hotel Meals: Dinner

days.heading: Day 2: Kigali City Tour and Transfer to Bwindi (Travel time: approx. 4 hours)
days.body: After breakfast, you will check out of the hotel and begin your Kigali city visit. First, you will visit the Kigali Genocide Memorial, a moving site that honors the memory of more than one million people who lost their lives during the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi. During your visit, you will watch powerful testimonies and learn about Rwanda’s history and remarkable recovery. Afterwards, you will continue your journey toward Bwindi Impenetrable National Park in Uganda. Upon arrival at your lodge, you will enjoy a late lunch. Later in the afternoon, you can relax and prepare for the following day’s unforgettable gorilla trekking experience. Accommodation: Rushaga Gorilla Lodge Meals: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 3: Gorilla Trekking Experience and Transfer to Volcanoes National Park
days.body: Your day begins early with breakfast before heading to the park headquarters for a detailed briefing from Uganda Wildlife Authority officials. Afterwards, you will enter the forest with experienced trackers in search of a mountain gorilla family. Once you locate the gorillas, you will spend an unforgettable hour observing them as they feed, play, and interact in their natural habitat. Watching these gentle giants at close range is truly one of Africa’s most powerful wildlife experiences. Because gorillas move freely through the forest, trekking time may vary from a few hours to most of the day. After the trek, you will return to the lodge for lunch. Later, you will drive back to Rwanda and continue to Volcanoes National Park. Accommodation: Kinigi Cottages Meals: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 4: Golden Monkey Trekking and Transfer to Kigali
days.body: After an early breakfast, your driver guide will transfer you to the Volcanoes National Park headquarters for a briefing. Soon after, you will begin your golden monkey trekking adventure in the bamboo forests. Golden monkeys are energetic and playful primates, which makes the trekking experience lively and rewarding. Compared to gorilla trekking, this activity is usually less demanding. After the trek, you will return to the lodge for lunch. Later, you will begin the drive back to Kigali. If time allows, you may stop at the lively Kimironko local market to explore authentic crafts and local produce. Finally, you will arrive at your hotel for dinner and overnight. Accommodation: Chez Lando Hotel Meals: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 5: Transfer to the Airport and Flight to Kenya
days.body: After breakfast, your driver will transfer you to Kigali International Airport for your scheduled flight to Nairobi. Upon arrival at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport, your Kenyan safari guide will welcome you and transfer you to your hotel in Nairobi for check-in and overnight. Accommodation: La Maison Royale Westlands Meals: Breakfast and Dinner

days.heading: Day 6: Transfer from Nairobi to Lake Nakuru National Park
days.body: After breakfast, you will meet your safari guide for a short briefing before beginning the drive to Lake Nakuru National Park. Along the way, you will travel through scenic farmlands and the dramatic landscapes of the Great Rift Valley. You will also stop briefly at a viewpoint to admire the stunning scenery. Upon arrival at the park, you will check in at your lodge and enjoy lunch. Later in the afternoon, you will head out for an exciting game drive. Lake Nakuru is famous for its white rhinos, large buffalo herds, and numerous bird species. In certain seasons, the lake also hosts spectacular flocks of flamingos. Accommodation: Lake Nakuru Lodge Meals: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 7: Transfer from Lake Nakuru to Maasai Mara National Reserve
days.body: After an early breakfast, you will depart Lake Nakuru and continue your journey toward the world-famous Maasai Mara National Reserve. The scenic drive takes you through the sweeping plains of Kenya and the Great Rift Valley landscapes. Once you arrive at the reserve, you will check in at your lodge and enjoy lunch. Later in the afternoon, you will set out on your first thrilling game drive in the Maasai Mara from around 3:30 PM until sunset. Afterwards, you will return to your lodge for dinner and overnight. Accommodation: Base Camp Maasai Mara Meal Plan: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

days.heading: Day 8: Maasai Mara National Reserve
days.body: Over the next two days, you will explore the vast landscapes of the Maasai Mara through morning and afternoon game drives. The reserve offers excellent opportunities to see lions, cheetahs, leopards, elephants, buffaloes, zebras, giraffes, hyenas, and numerous antelope species. Furthermore, the Maasai Mara is one of Africa’s richest wildlife ecosystems and supports an incredible variety of predators and birdlife. Most importantly, the reserve hosts the world-famous Great Wildebeest Migration. Between July and October, more than 1.2 million wildebeest and zebras move from the Serengeti into the Maasai Mara in search of greener pastures. During this dramatic movement, predators follow the herds, creating remarkable wildlife viewing opportunities. Each evening, you will return to your lodge for dinner and a relaxing overnight stay. Accommodation: Base Camp Maasai Mara Meal Plan: Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner

days.heading: Day 10: Maasai Mara: Nairobi: Departure
days.body: Finally, enjoy breakfast at the camp before checking out. Afterwards, you will begin the drive back to Nairobi. Depending on your schedule, you may enjoy a final en-route game drive as you exit the reserve. Upon arrival in Nairobi, you may optionally enjoy lunch at the famous Carnivore Restaurant if time permits. Later, your driver will transfer you to Jomo Kenyatta International Airport for your international departure flight. This concludes your 10 Days Uganda Gorilla Trekking and Maasai Mara Migration Adventure. Meal Plan: Breakfast & Lunch

During your visit, you will have the opportunity to watch and listen to powerful testimonies and video clips from survivors, offering deep insight into Rwanda’s history and resilience. Following this moving experience, you will embark on a scenic drive to Bwindi. Upon arrival at your booked accommodation, you will enjoy a late lunch and spend the remainder of the afternoon at leisure, relaxing and preparing for the following day’s unforgettable gorilla trekking adventure

days.heading: Day 3: Gorilla Trekking Experience in Bwindi and Transfer to Rwanda Volcanoes NP
days.body: Start your day with an early morning cup of coffee, then prepare for a briefing conducted by Uganda Wildlife Authority officials. days.heading: Day 5: Transfer to the airport to fly to Tanzania

days.heading: Day 6: Game drives in Tarangire National Park
days.body: Embark on a thrilling journey to Tarangire National Park, renowned for its vast elephant herds and iconic baobab trees. As the sun sets, enjoy a sumptuous dinner at your lodge, enveloped in the sounds of the African wilderness

days.body: Today, you will descend 2,000 feet (over 600 meters) to the floor of the Ngorongoro Crater for a memorable game drives. Your tour will take you through lush forested areas, home to monkeys and elephants, and into the lake region, where flamingos often gather in striking numbers. You’ll also traverse the open savannah, where lions roam and hunt for prey. After your crater tour, return to the lodge for lunch. In the afternoon, drive to the Central Serengeti and enjoy a game drive en route through the park. Dinner and overnight stay at your lodge

days.heading: Day 9: Full Day Game Drives into Serengeti National Park
days.body: After breakfast, set out for a full-day game drive across the vast, open plains of the Serengeti. days.heading: Day 6: Game drives in Maasai Mara
days.body: Spend the next two days immersed in the incredible wilderness of the Maasai Mara, exploring its vast landscapes on thrilling game drives. Other remarkable sightings may include buffalos, zebras, spotted hyenas, Masai giraffes, elands, gazelles, hippos, black rhinos, and many more fascinating creatures that call this ecosystem home. The Maasai Mara, one of Africa’s most iconic wildlife reserves, boasts an exceptional diversity of predators, scavengers, plains game, and prolific birdlife. It is also the stage for the world-famous Great Migration, an awe-inspiring natural spectacle that occurs annually between July and October, when over 1.2 million wildebeest and zebras cross from the Serengeti in search of greener pastures. Continue with a captivating Spice Tour, Zanzibar’s second-largest source of income after tourism. Drive through lush countryside landscapes filled with tropical greenery and visit spice plantations where you’ll see, smell, and even taste a variety of exotic spices and seasonal fruits. Depending on the time of year, you may sample jackfruit, pineapple, bananas, green coconut juice, durian, love apples, lychee, and soursop, among others. Discover aromatic spices such as cloves, cardamom, cinnamon, black pepper, turmeric, vanilla, and nutmeg, each offering a burst of vibrant flavor and scent. This is also the ideal place to purchase locally made perfumes and oils at affordable prices. The guided walking tour takes you through villages and spice farms, where you’ll witness farm workers climbing trees and harvesting spices, offering you an interactive and immersive experience. In the evening, return to your beach lodge for dinner and an overnight stay

After enjoying a delightful en route lunch, you will arrive at Nyungwe National Park in the afternoon. The rest of the day will be yours to unwind and enjoy at your leisure

days.heading: Day 6: Chimpanzee tracking and canopy walk
days.body:
