Upon arrival, you will attend a briefing at the park headquarters before embarking on an exhilarating chimpanzee trekking adventure. Once the chimpanzees are located, you will spend an hour observing their behavior in their natural habitat, a truly unforgettable experience. After the trek, enjoy a well-deserved lunch before heading to the renowned canopy walk, a 70-meter-long suspended metallic bridge offering breathtaking views of the forest. With some luck, you might spot additional primates or unique bird species during your walk. In the afternoon, return to your lodge for a relaxing dinner and overnight stay

Meal Plan: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 7: Lowland Gorilla trekking in Kahuzi Biega
days.body:
Begin your day with an early morning cup of coffee before crossing the border into the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Upon arrival, proceed to the park headquarters for a briefing on your highly anticipated gorilla trekking adventure. Equipped with a packed lunch, you will venture into the jungle to track the elusive lowland gorillas in their natural habitat. Once you locate the gorillas, you will spend an hour observing their fascinating social behavior and capturing unforgettable photographs. This trek requires a reasonable level of fitness, along with essential items such as sturdy walking shoes, packed food, mineral water, insect repellent, sunscreen, and a hat. After this extraordinary experience, return to enjoy lunch before heading back to Rwanda. You will then be transferred to Rwanda at your booked hotel where you can relax and unwind for the rest of the day

Meal Plan: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 8: Transfer to Volcanoes National Park, boat trip on Lake Kivu Travel time +4hrs
days.body:
In the morning, following breakfast, set out on a picturesque boat trip to explore the stunning Lake Kivu. During this excursion, you will have the chance to visit several islands and observe the diverse bird species that inhabit the area. After the boat trip, continue your journey with a transfer to Volcanoes National Park, stopping en route at the Kinunu Coffee Plantation for an insightful visit. Enjoy lunch before proceeding to Volcanoes National Park, where you will settle in for dinner and an overnight stay

Meal Plan: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 9: Diana Fossey Tomb Hike
days.body:
After breakfast, your driver-guide will pick you up from your accommodation and take you to the park. At 7:00 AM, you will arrive at the park headquarters in Kinigi Village, where a ranger will provide a detailed briefing on the rules and guidelines for the hike to Dian Fossey’s grave. Following the briefing, you will begin your journey into the jungle. Upon reaching the tomb, you will have an hour to explore the historic site, soak in the tranquil surroundings, and capture memorable photographs. After the hike, return to your lodge to enjoy dinner and unwind with an overnight stay

Meal Plan: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 10: Transfer for Climbing the Volcano Bisoke
days.body:
After breakfast, you will head to the park headquarters to begin your day’s adventure. At the RDB Office, a park ranger will brief you on the hiking guidelines and what to expect during the trek. Following the briefing, you will embark on the ascent to the summit of Mount Bisoke, where you will be rewarded with breathtaking views of its stunning Crater Lake. The hike typically takes 5 to 7 hours, depending on your group’s pace and level of experience. Once the trek is complete, you will return to your hotel for a well-deserved rest and relaxation

Meal Plan: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 11: Golden monkeys & Transfer to Bwindi via Cyanika border Travel time + 5 hrs
days.body:
After a relaxed breakfast, you will set off for Volcanoes National Park to embark on an exciting golden monkey trekking adventure. This unique experience offers the opportunity to observe these playful and endangered primates in their natural habitat. Later, you will continue your journey across the border to Bwindi Impenetrable Forest National Park in Uganda. Upon arrival, spend the evening at your leisure, resting and preparing for the incredible gorilla trekking experience that awaits you. Enjoy dinner and an overnight stay at your lodge

Meal Plan: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 12: Gorilla Trekking experience
days.body:
Start your day with an early breakfast before heading to the park headquarters for a briefing on your gorilla trekking adventure. Equipped with your packed lunch, you will venture into the jungle on an exhilarating trek to find the majestic mountain gorillas. As you explore their natural habitat, you will have the chance to observe their unique behaviors and social interactions in the wild. Once you locate the gorillas, you’ll enjoy the extraordinary privilege of spending one hour in their presence, capturing unforgettable photos and creating lifelong memories. The trek duration can vary from half a day to a full day, depending on the gorillas’ movements. After this once-in-a-lifetime experience, return to your lodge for lunch. In the afternoon relax, reflect on the day’s incredible encounters, and review your photos before settling in for a restful overnight stay

Meal Plan: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner

days.heading: Day 13: Lake Bunyonyi boat and transfer back for the departure
days.body:
After a leisurely breakfast, pack your belongings and prepare for the return journey to Kigali. Along the way, take a serene boat trip on Lake Bunyonyi, celebrated for its breathtaking landscapes, abundant birdlife, and tranquil atmosphere. Immerse yourself in the picturesque scenery of this natural paradise before continuing your drive to Kigali. You will arrive in the city with ample time to catch your departure flight after the memorable 13 Day Magical Rwanda - DRC - Uganda Gorilla Round Trip

Meal Plan: Breakfast and Lunch

inclusions: Transportation on a 4x4 safari vehicle with pop up roof
Service of an English-speaking driver guide
1 Gorilla permit per person in Uganda
1 Gorilla permit per person in DRC
Boat cruises as mentioned in the itinerary
Game drives as mentioned in the itinerary

title: 15 Days Great Kenya – Uganda & Rwanda Road Trip Safari Adventure
overview:
This 15 Days Wildlife and Primate Safari will give you a great experience of visiting and exploring Kenya and Uganda in depth, wind up in Rwanda. You will have a great experience to visit Lake Nakuru, Lake Naivasha and Maasai Mara and fly to Uganda be able to visit 4 of the main Uganda most visited national parks for a great wildlife encounter, giving a greater opportunity to spot the Big 5 and also another wonderful opportunity to see the chimpanzees and gorillas in their wilderness. This will be an amazing life trip to remember. This is a great intrepid safari that gives you a great country side experience to explore the country side

Destination: Kenya –Uganda - Rwanda

15 Days Wildlife and Primate Safari
facts:
Tour Name: 15 Days Great Kenya – Uganda & Rwanda Road Trip Safari Adventure
Duration: 15 days
Countries: Rwanda, Uganda, Kenya
Itinerary: 14 day-by-day sections
Price: From $9,158 /person (2 pax)

days.heading: Day 1: Arrival and transfer to Hotel
days.body:
Upon arrival at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport, you will be met by your driver-guide and transferred to your hotel in Nairobi for check-in. Dinner and an overnight stay at the hotel

Standard accommodation: Maison Royale Westlands

days.heading: Day 2: Transfer Nairobi to Masai National Park: Travel time 5.5 hrs
days.body:
Enjoy breakfast at your hotel, followed by an introduction to your safari driver-guide and a pre-safari briefing. Afterwards, depart for the world-renowned Maasai Mara National Reserve. Upon arrival, check in at your lodge and enjoy a delicious lunch. Later in the afternoon, embark on your first exciting game drive in the Maasai Mara, from 3:30 PM to 6:00 PM. Return to the lodge for dinner and an overnight stay

Standard accommodation: Base Camp Maasai Mara

days.heading: Day 3: Game drives in Maasai Mara
days.body:
Spend the next two days immersed in the incredible wilderness of the Maasai Mara, exploring its vast landscapes on thrilling game drives. As you traverse the reserve, keep an eye out for the Big Cats like lions, cheetahs, and leopards as well as a variety of antelopes and bird species. Other remarkable sightings may include buffalos, zebras, spotted hyenas, Masai giraffes, elands, gazelles, hippos, black rhinos, and many more fascinating creatures that call this ecosystem home. The Maasai Mara, one of Africa’s most iconic wildlife reserves, boasts an exceptional diversity of predators, scavengers, plains game, and prolific birdlife. It is also the stage for the world-famous Great Migration, an awe-inspiring natural spectacle that occurs annually between July and October, when over 1.2 million wildebeest and zebras cross from the Serengeti in search of greener pastures. Return to your lodge in the evening for dinner and an overnight stay

Standard accommodation: Base Camp Maasai Mara

days.heading: Day 5: Transfer from Maasai Mara to Lake Naivasha
days.body:
Enjoy breakfast at your lodge or camp. Check out by 08:00 hrs and depart for Lake Naivasha. Upon arrival, have lunch at your resort. Spend the afternoon head for a picturesque boat ride offering close encounters with hippos and other wildlife. Later you will back to your lodge for the dinner and overnight stay

Standard accommodation: Naivasha Kongoni Lodge

days.heading: Day 6: Transfer from Lake Naivasha to Lake Nakuru National Park
days.body:
After breakfast, depart for Lake Nakuru, enjoying a scenic drive along the floor of the Great Rift Valley with a brief stopover to take in the stunning views. Upon arrival, check in at your lodge and have lunch. In the afternoon, head out for a game drive in Lake Nakuru National Park. This park is renowned for its population of endangered rhinos, the elegant Rothschild’s giraffes, and when in season, a vibrant display of lesser flamingos along the lake shore. A variety of other mammals and bird species also inhabit the park, offering a rich and rewarding safari experience. Return to the lodge for dinner and an overnight stay

Standard accommodation: Lake Nakuru Lodge

days.heading: Day 7: Transfer Lake Nakuru to Nairobi and fly to Uganda
days.body:
Early morning breakfast at your lodge. Check out of rooms and depart for a transfer to Jomo Kenyatta International airport for boarding your flight to Entebbe in Uganda. Upon arrival at the Entebbe international airport, You will be warmly welcomed to Uganda by our guide who will be waiting for you at the airport and transfer you to the hotel for dinner and overnight stay

Standard accommodation: Papyrus Guest House

days.heading: Day 8: Transfer from Entebbe to Murchison Falls. Travel time +5hrs
days.body:
After enjoying a delightful breakfast at 07:00 hrs, you will set off for Murchison Falls National Park, one of Uganda’s most visited and iconic parks. En route, make a memorable stop at the Ziwa Rhino Sanctuary for an exciting on foot rhino tracking experience, offering a unique opportunity to encounter one of the Big Five up close. Continue your journey into the park, where you may spot a variety of wildlife along the way as you head to your lodge. Spend the evening at leisure, unwinding and soaking in the serene surroundings of the African wilderness. Dinner and overnight stay at the lodge

Standard accommodation: Fort Murchison

days.heading: Day 9: Game drive and Boat cruise at Murchison Falls NP
days.body:
Start your day with a refreshing cup of African coffee before heading out on an early morning game drive. Accompanied by your expert guide, you’ll have the opportunity to spot a wide array of wildlife including elephants, lions, Cape buffalo, Rothschild’s giraffes, hartebeest, waterbuck, oribi, bushbuck, Bohor reedbuck, hyenas, and if you’re lucky, the elusive leopard. Lunch will be provided during the course of the day. In the afternoon, enjoy a scenic boat safari along the Nile River towards the base of the magnificent Murchison Falls. Along the way, you’ll be closely observed by basking crocodiles, pods of hippos, herds of buffalo, water birds, primates, and other wildlife drawn to the river’s edge. Return to the lodge in the evening for dinner and an overnight stay

Standard accommodation: Fort Murchison

days.heading: Day 10: Murchison Falls: Kibale Forest National Park. Travel time +6hrs
days.body:
In the morning, you will embark on a leisurely drive through the lush countryside toward Kibale Forest National Park, with scenic stops along the way, including panoramic views of the distant Rift Valley escarpment. You will arrive at Kibale Forest in the late afternoon and spend the evening unwinding at the lodge, where dinner and an overnight stay await

Standard accommodation: Chimpanzee Forest Guest House

days.heading: Day 11: Chimpanzee Trekking and Transfer to Queen. Travel time +5hrs
days.body:
Today, enjoy an early breakfast before heading to the park headquarters for a briefing ahead of your chimpanzee tracking experience. During the trek, you may also encounter other primates such as Vervet monkeys, Blue Hoest monkeys, and Black-and-white colobus monkeys, among others. After the trek, return to the lodge for lunch. In the afternoon, you will continue your journey to Queen Elizabeth National Park, one of Uganda’s most visited savannah parks, located in the western region of the country. The park offers stunning views of the Kazinga Channel, teeming with wildlife and well known for its unique and scenic boat trips, often highlighted by large gatherings of hippos. Spend the evening at your leisure, relaxing at the lodge

Standard accommodation: Twin Lakes Safari Lodge

days.heading: Day 12: Morning Game drive and afternoon Boat cruise
days.body:
In the morning, you will embark on an early game drive in the Kasenyi plains, a prime area for wildlife viewing, with the chance to spot a variety of animals including big cats and numerous antelope species. Afterwards, return to the lodge for a late breakfast followed by lunch. In the afternoon, head to the Kazinga Channel for a scenic boat cruise, offering close-up views of hippos, crocodiles, and other wildlife along the water’s edge

Standard accommodation: Twin Lakes Safari Lodge

days.heading: Day13: Transfer to Bwindi National Park. Travel time +6hrs
days.body:
After a relaxed breakfast in the morning, you will set off on a scenic drive to Bwindi Impenetrable National Park, located in the southern region of Uganda. Renowned for being home to nearly half of the world’s remaining mountain gorillas, Bwindi is also a paradise for bird enthusiasts. This lush highland rainforest, one of the most biologically diverse ecosystems on earth that is rich with primates, exotic bird species, misty valleys, rolling hilltops, and papyrus swamps. Upon arrival, enjoy dinner and an overnight stay at your booked lodge

Standard accommodation: Rushaga Gorilla Lodge

days.heading: Day 14: Gorilla Trekking Experience
days.body:
Start the day with an early breakfast in preparation for your gorilla trekking adventure, which begins at 08:00 AM with a briefing by the tourism office staff. Be sure to carry essentials such as a rain jacket, drinking water, snacks, and sturdy jungle boots. You will then be guided into the forest to track the specific gorilla group you’ve been assigned. Mountain gorilla trekking is widely regarded as one of the most thrilling and unforgettable wildlife experiences in the world. The trek can last anywhere from 2 to 6 hours, depending on the location of the gorillas, but every moment is worth the effort. Spend the afternoon at your leisure, relaxing at the lodge, before enjoying dinner and an overnight stay at your booked accommodation

Standard accommodation: Rushaga Gorilla Lodge

days.heading: Day 15: Transfer from Bwindi to Kigali
days.body:
Enjoy breakfast in the morning before boarding your jeep for the return journey to Kigali. En route, you will stop for lunch and make a brief visit through the city. One of the key highlights is a visit to the Kigali Genocide Memorial, the final resting place of over 250,000 victims of the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi. Afterwards, you will have the opportunity to explore Kimironko Market, one of the city’s bustling local markets, where you can shop for souvenirs and local crafts. You will then be transferred to Kigali International Airport in time for your late evening flight back home

Days Wildlife and Primate Safari

title: 16 Days Wildebeest Migration & Gorilla Trekking Safari
overview:
This 16 Days Wildebeest Migration and Gorilla Trekking Safari offers you a great chance to explore East Africa, thus Kenya, Tanzania, Rwanda and Uganda, while visiting the key attraction in each country and you have a total wilderness experience to not just see the BIG 5, but to also witness the great migration either in Maasai Mara or Northern Serengeti, or both, as you also visit one of the world wonder’s The Ngorongoro Crater, to spot some Big 5, as they are usually encountered in the crater. You will as well be able to experience the chimpanzee trekking and golden monkey trekking in Rwanda, to set you up for the gorilla trekking encounter in Uganda. The safari will take you all away from Kenya through Tanzania, fly to Rwanda, and cross to Uganda

Destination: Kenya – Tanzania - Rwanda - Uganda

16 Days Wildebeest Migration and Gorilla Trekking Safari
facts:
Tour Name: 16 Days Wildebeest Migration & Gorilla Trekking Safari
Duration: 16 days
Countries: Rwanda, Uganda, Kenya, Tanzania
Itinerary: 16 day-by-day sections
Price: From $9,668 /person (2 pax)

days.heading: Day 1: Airport Transfer to Hotel
days.body:
Upon arrival at Jomo Kenyatta International Airport, you will be warmly welcomed by your driver-guide, who will transfer you to your city hotel for check-in. Enjoy dinner and an overnight stay at the hotel

Standard accommodation: Maison Royale Westlands

days.heading: Day 2: Transfer from Nairobi to Lake Nakuru National Park: Travel time 3.5 hrs
days.body:
After breakfast at your hotel, you will be introduced to your safari driver for a pre-safari briefing, followed by a prompt departure for Lake Nakuru National Park at 08:30 hrs. En route, enjoy a scenic drive through picturesque farmlands and the floor of the Great Rift Valley, with a brief stopover for photo opportunities and sightseeing. You will arrive at your lodge or tented camp in time for lunch and check-in. In the afternoon, set out on a thrilling game drive in Lake Nakuru National Park, renowned for hosting four of the Big Five, along with a rich diversity of birdlife and other wildlife. The park’s key highlights include sightings of white rhinos and, during certain months, the spectacular presence of both lesser and greater flamingos. Return to your lodge for dinner and an overnight stay

Standard accommodation: Lake Nakuru Lodge

days.heading: Day 3: Lake Nakuru: Maasai Mara National Reserve: Travel time 6.5 hrs
days.body:
Enjoy an early breakfast starting from 06:30 hrs. At 07:15 hrs, depart Lake Nakuru and embark on a scenic drive to the world-famous Maasai Mara National Reserve. Upon arrival, check in at your lodge or tented camp and settle in before enjoying a delicious lunch. Later in the afternoon, experience your first game drive in the Maasai Mara from 15:30 hrs to 18:00 hrs, where you’ll have the chance to spot a wide array of wildlife in one of Africa’s most iconic safari destinations. Return to your accommodation for dinner and an overnight stay

Standard accommodation: Base Camp Maasai Mara

days.heading: Day 4: Maasai Mara Game drives
days.body:
Spend the entire day exploring the vast and breathtaking Maasai Mara National Reserve, with game drives that offer an incredible opportunity to encounter its rich and diverse wildlife. As you traverse the plains, keep an eye out for resident big cats such as lions, cheetahs, and leopards, as well as elephants, buffalos, zebras, spotted hyenas, Masai giraffes, elands, gazelles, hippos, black rhinos, and an array of bird species. Renowned as one of Africa’s most iconic wildlife destinations, the Maasai Mara is home to the legendary Big Five, along with a variety of predators, scavengers, plains game, and abundant birdlife. Between July and October, the reserve becomes the stage for one of nature’s greatest spectacles, the annual wildebeest migration when over 1.2 million wildebeest and zebras cross over from the Serengeti in search of greener pastures. Return to your lodge in the evening for dinner and an overnight stay

Standard accommodation: Base Camp Maasai Mara

days.heading: Day 5: Transfer Maasai Mara to Northern Serengeti: Travel time + 8.5 hrs
days.body:
After breakfast, collect your picnic lunch and set off for the iconic Serengeti, known for its vast, seemingly endless plains. Enjoy a scenic three-hour drive to the Isebania border, where you will complete immigration formalities before continuing into the northern region of Serengeti National Park. Along the way, enjoy en route game viewing as you search for the resident big cats and other wildlife that inhabit this remarkable ecosystem. Arrive at your lodge in the evening for dinner and an overnight stay

Standard accommodation: Mara Kati Kati Tented Camp

days.heading: Day 6: Game drives in Northern Serengeti
days.body:
Spend the full day exploring the northern reaches of the Serengeti, an area renowned for exceptional wildlife sightings. Between June and October, this region becomes the stage for the dramatic Great Migration, as vast herds of wildebeest and zebras move through the savannah woodlands and gather along the crocodile-infested Mara River. During this period, river crossings are frequently witnessed, offering a chance to observe one of nature’s most awe-inspiring spectacles. After an exhilarating day of game viewing, return to your lodge for dinner and an overnight stay

Standard accommodation: Mara Kati Kati Tented Camp

days.heading: Day 7: Game drives from North Serengeti to Central Serengeti
days.body:
Begin your day with a hearty breakfast, followed by a morning game drive in the northern Serengeti, offering one last chance to spot the region’s incredible wildlife. You will then depart for the Central Serengeti, enjoying game viewing along the way. In the afternoon, explore the renowned Seronera area, the heart of the Serengeti and one of its most wildlife-rich regions. Known for its high concentration of both predators and prey, Seronera offers an exceptional game viewing experience as you traverse diverse habitats and stunning landscapes. Return to your lodge in the evening for dinner and an overnight stay

Standard accommodation: Serengeti Kati Kati Tented Camp

days.heading: Day 8: Leave Serengeti for game drive in Ngorongoro Crater: Karatu
days.body:
After breakfast, depart for the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, one of Africa’s most remarkable natural wonders. En route, you have the option to visit the Olduvai Gorge, an important archaeological site where Louis and Mary Leakey made groundbreaking discoveries related to early human evolution. The on-site museum offers a fascinating insight into the history of humankind and is a worthwhile stop for those interested in anthropology. Later in the afternoon, descend the steep walls of the Ngorongoro Crater for game drives along the crater floor, renowned for its exceptional density of wildlife. You may encounter a wide variety of animals, including lions, elephants (notably large bulls), cheetahs, spotted hyenas, black rhinos, wildebeests, jackals, baboons, buffalos, hippos, flamingos on the crater lakes, and even the elusive caracal. After your game drive, continue to Karatu, located along the scenic Ngorongoro Highlands, where you will enjoy dinner and an overnight stay

Standard accommodation: Marela Valley Lodge

days.heading: Day 9: Transfer to Kilimanjaro Airport to fly to Rwanda
days.body:
After breakfast at your lodge, check out by 08:30 hrs and begin your drive to Arusha City. Upon arrival, you will be transferred directly to Kilimanjaro International Airport to board your afternoon flight to Kigali, scheduled for 14:00 hrs. Upon arrival at Kigali International Airport, proceed through customs and immigration. You will then be warmly welcomed by our driver guide, who will greet you with a smile and introduce you to the beauty of Rwanda, affectionately known as the Land of a Thousand Hills. From here, you will be transferred to your booked hotel for check-in, followed by dinner and an overnight stay

Standard accommodation: Chez Lando Hotel

days.heading: Day 10: Transfer to Nyungwe National Park. Travel time +5 hours
days.body:
Enjoy an early morning buffet breakfast before checking out of your hotel and beginning your journey toward Rwanda’s Western Province. En route, make a stop in the Southern Province to visit the Ethnographic Museum, an enriching experience that offers deep insights into Rwanda’s cultural heritage, traditional lifestyles, and the historical leadership system of kingship. Lunch will be enjoyed along the way. In the afternoon, you will arrive at Nyungwe National Park and proceed to your booked hotel for relaxation and an overnight stay

Standard accommodation: Maravilla Kivu Resort

days.heading: Day 11: Chimpanzee tracking and canopy walk way
days.body:
After an early morning cup of rich African coffee, depart from your hotel for an exciting day of exploration in Nyungwe Forest, renowned for its remarkable biodiversity and home to 13 species of primates. Upon arrival at the park, you will receive a briefing before setting off on your chimpanzee trekking adventure. Once the chimpanzees are located, you will have the special opportunity to spend one unforgettable hour observing them in their natural habitat. During the trek, you may also encounter other primates, including the famous Angola colobus monkeys and a variety of bird species. After the chimpanzee trek, enjoy lunch before heading out for the renowned canopy walk, a thrilling experience that offers panoramic views of the lush rainforest from above. Later in the evening, return to your lodge for dinner and an overnight stay

Standard accommodation: Maravilla Kivu Resort

days.heading: Day 12: Transfer to Musanze with enroute boat trip in Lake Kivu. Travel time + 5hrs
days.body:
Wake up early to witness the breathtaking sunrise over the tranquil waters of Lake Kivu, followed by a leisurely breakfast. Afterwards, embark on a scenic boat ride to explore the stunning islands scattered across this magnificent lake. During the excursion, you will enjoy a nature walk on one of the islands, famously known for hosting thousands of bats. Lake Kivu is also a haven for bird lovers, often referred to as a birding paradise. You may spot a variety of bird species such as cormorants, pied kingfishers, weaver birds, herons, and many others. Later, return to the mainland and begin your journey to Musanze, a scenic drive of approximately three hours. Located near Volcanoes National Park, Musanze serves as the primary hub for visitors, with most accommodations situated in this vibrant tourism area since there are no lodges within the park itself. Dinner and overnight stay at your booked lodge

Standard accommodation: La Palme Hotel

days.heading: Day 13: Golden Monkey Trekking & transfer to Bwindi Travel time + 2hrs
days.body:
After a warm early morning breakfast, you will be picked up by our professional safari driver-guide and transferred to the Volcanoes National Park headquarters for a briefing ahead of your golden monkey trekking adventure. Much like gorilla trekking, this experience involves tracking these lively and endangered primates through the forest, though it is generally less strenuous than gorilla trekking. After the trek, enjoy a relaxed afternoon before beginning your transfer to Bwindi Impenetrable Forest via the Cyanika Border. Upon arrival, check in to your booked accommodation. Dinner and overnight stay at the lodge

Standard accommodation: Rushaga Gorilla Lodge

days.heading: Day 14: Gorilla Trekking Experience
days.body:
Begin your day with an early morning cup of coffee before heading to the park headquarters for a detailed briefing on gorilla trekking. Equipped with your packed lunch, you will then venture into the dense jungle in search of the elusive mountain gorillas, experiencing the wonder of observing them in their natural habitat. Once you locate the gorilla family, you will have the extraordinary opportunity to spend one full hour in their presence, watching their interactions, social behaviors, and capturing unforgettable moments through your camera lens. The trek may last from a few hours to most of the day, depending on the gorillas’ movements. After the trek, return to your lodge for a well-deserved lunch. Spend the rest of the afternoon at leisure, relaxing and reviewing the incredible photos and memories captured during your unforgettable encounter with the gorillas

Standard accommodation: Rushaga Gorilla Lodge

days.heading: Day 15: Boat ride and transfer to Kigali Travel time + 4 hrs
days.body:
After a relaxed breakfast, you will transfer to the stunning Lake Bunyonyi, renowned for its natural beauty and tranquil atmosphere. Here, you will enjoy a peaceful moment of relaxation, followed by a scenic canoe ride across the lake’s calm waters. As you glide along, take in the breathtaking views of the surrounding hills and numerous islands scattered throughout this spectacular lake. Lake Bunyonyi is also a birdwatcher’s paradise, home to a variety of bird species that can be spotted during your excursion. After the boat ride, you will begin your transfer to Kigali, with an en route lunch. If time permits, you will enjoy a brief Kigali city tour before being transferred to your hotel for dinner and an overnight stay

Standard accommodation: Chez Lando Hotel

days.heading: Day 16: Transfer to the airport for departure
days.body:
After enjoying your morning breakfast, embark on a brief Kigali city tour. Depending on the scheduled time of your flight back home, you will then be transferred to Kigali International Airport to catch your departure flight

Days Wildebeest Migration and Gorilla Trekking Safari

title: 5 Days Marangu Route Kilimanjaro Hiking
overview: Take part in hiking the mighty Mount Kilimanjaro when you visit Tanzania on this 5 Days Marangu Route Kilimanjaro Hiking safari. to take part in our adventurous Tanzania Safaris
facts:
Tour Name: 5 Days Marangu Route Kilimanjaro Hiking
Duration: 5 days
Countries: Tanzania
Itinerary: 7 day-by-day sections
Price: On request

days.heading: Day 1: Arrival
days.body:
Touch down at the Kilimanjaro International Airport where your own personal driver will be waiting to greet you. Let your driver whisk you away to your chosen hotel in the bright and bustling city of Arusha – gateway to Tanzania.

Arusha is the beating heart of the wild – the last port of civilization before heading out into dense jungles and rich savannah plains. The markets of Arusha burst with color, and throng with locals picking up their weekly wares. The numerous cafes sell dark and deliriously good coffee from the plantations, and close by the infamous National Park lures visitors in to explore her evocative Maasai culture and exotic flora and fauna. In the evening you will enjoy a quick briefing which will be conducted by professional Bush 2 City Mountain Guide about your trekking, and to ensure if you are ready for climbing. ACCOMMODATION: Plante Lodge Arusha

days.heading: Day 2: MARANGU GATE TO MANDARA HUT
days.body:
After breakfast at your hotel, you will check out and depart to Marangu Gate, about 4 hours’ drive from Arusha town, as a getaway point to the summit of Mount Kilimanjaro, and you will be accompanied by mountain guides and crews all the way. After the registration process at the gate you will start trekking toward Mandara Hut as the first where you will spend your overnight. The walk will take you about 3 to 4 hours and you will cover an altitude of 1900 meters up to 2720 meters. Along the way, you will have enough time to rest and have lunch before continue with the trek while learning about the mountain history, vegetation’s and different species of wildlife found at the park such as birds and animals. This will be your first day at this altitude, so it is strongly recommended you to read the following instructions from this point on

• Abstain from consuming alcohol and caffeine

days.heading: Day 2: UMBWE GATE TO UMBWE CAMP
days.body:
Your guide and climb support crew arrive at your hotel in the morning. Introductions and a last brief equipment check precede your drive to the Umbwe Gate of Kilimanjaro National Park. This entrance, situated at 1,640 m above sea level, is where your trek starts. The head-guide will finalize the permits and registration for search and rescue services. Your first day trekking is meant to bring you to Umbwe Camp for your first mountain overnight. Climbing up to 2,930 m is a long haul with a significant increase in altitude, so find the right pace for the whole group and stick with it. As this part of Umbwe route goes through rain forest with its probability of rain showers- do not forget your raincoat. Your support crew will have prepared the camp and dinner by the time you get there. This being the group’s first night at this elevation, we recommend that you follow the below rules from here on

• Do not consume any alcohol and minimize your caffeine intake

• Drinking no less than 4 liters of water per day is a good way to keep yourself hydrated. Take it in small amounts but frequently

• We encourage our clients to use Diamox in the mornings prior to the day’s climb. This reduces altitude sickness symptoms. Consult your doctor on the use of Diamox before leaving home on this trip

Nightly discomfort often accompanies acclimatization. However, while such symptoms as headaches and nausea are common, make sure you inform your guide of them immediately. days.heading: Day 3: UMBWE CAMP TOBARRANCO CAMP
days.body: Early wakeup, breakfast and the start of trekking to Barranco Camp. The rainforest will quickly give way to brush, and if it is not too cloudy you will be able to see Meru Volcano for the first time. Trekking on Umbwe route for this day will be of a moderate length, and around lunchtime you will reach Barranco Camp (3,960 m), which is nestled inside a huge volcanic fault. Lunch will be provided here, and then you have the opportunity to relax for the rest of the day, which significantly facilitates the acclimatization process. Change in Elevation: Umbwe Camp (2,930 m), Barranco Camp (3,960 m) Hiking distance: 6 km Hiking time: 4–5 hours ACCOMMODATION: Barranco Camp Mt. Kilimanjaro

days.body: Early wakeup, breakfast and the start of summiting Barranco Wall (we recommend you leave the camp as early as possible to avoid crowds of the other groups, After the climb you can have a rest and take photos in front of the Kibo volcano. Then you start a more difficult hike to Karanga Camp, which features numerous ascents and descents during the route, but don’t worry: our guides are experts at choosing an optimal pace for the group. After reaching the camp you will be offered Hot lunch. After a couple of hours you will have to complete an acclimatization hike in the direction of Barafu Camp with a 300-meter gain in altitude, and then descent back down to the camp. Note:The acclimatization hike is an easy trek with a slight gain in altitude done in order to speed up the acclimatization process. You should take the acclimatization hikes very seriously. Their help increase your chances of successfully summiting Kilimanjaro and save you from the consequences of altitude sickness. Kilimanjaro

days.body: In the morning after breakfast you begin your way to Barafu Summit Camp (4,640 m), the starting point for a night summiting Uhuru Peak (5,895 m). Our team will set up a camp for you ahead of time, including tents and sleeping bags, so you can relax. After regaining strength, you have to complete an acclimatization hike towards the intermediate Kosovo Summit Camp (4,800 m) and then back to Barafu Camp, where you will be served a hot dinner. It is better to spend the remainder of the day resting and sleeping before night summiting. days.body: At the night you will Departure from Barafu Camp (4,640 m) and start summiting Kilimanjaro: Uhuru Peak (5,895 m). Simply the climb is relatively simple; though, the most challenging part is the high altitude where each pair of climbers will get a personal guide for the entire ascent to monitor your physical and mental conditions. After your successful ascent to Uhuru Peak, you can descend to the nearest glacier if you wish. Then you will return to Barafu Camp and after a 2-hour rest continue your descent to Millennium Camp (3,820 m). Note:Don’t forget that 90% of all accidents occur during the descent, including all broken arms and legs. Please pay attention to your feet, as there is a high risk of damaging your toenails. days.heading: Day 7: MILLENNIUM CAMP TO MWEKA GATE

days.heading: Day 4: SHIRA CAMP TO THE LAVA TOWER TO BARRANCO CAMP
days.body: From the Shira Camp (3,845 m), you continue to the east, passing the junction towards the key point of the route Lava Tower (4,630 m). The climb is for some 5kms and will take approximately 8 hours. As you continue, your direction this section of the route has a lot of ascents and descents that end in a camp at over 4,600 meters. It might be difficult, and you may feel some discomfort, but in order to successfully acclimatize to the altitude you have to spend at least 1-2 hours here, and here is where you will have lunch. Now you will descend to Barranco Camp at an altitude of 3,960 meters. Here you can see the famous Barranco Wall, impressive in both its massive size and stiffness. Then the time to rest, enjoy dinner and overnight. Note:If one or more participants feel sick, the group may refrain from passing the Lava Tower and adjust the route, following instead the road for porters. In this case you will not reach an altitude of 4,630 meters, getting up only to a maximum of 4,400 meters. days.heading: Day 5: BARRANCO TO BARAFU CAMP
days.body: Early wakeup, breakfast and the start of summiting Barranco Wall (we recommend you leave the camp as early as possible to avoid crowds of the other groups). Hiking up the gorge wall is not difficult and only takes around an hour. After the climb you can have a rest and take photos in front of the Kibo volcano. Then you start a more difficult hike to Karanga Camp, which features numerous ascents and descents during the route, but don’t worry: our guides are experts at choosing an optimal pace for the group. After reaching the camp you will be offered warm lunch. After a couple of hours you will have to complete ascend to Barafu Camp (4,640 m) where you will be served a hot dinner. It is better to spend the remainder of the day resting and sleeping before night summiting. days.heading: Day 6: BARAFU CAMP TO UHURU (SUMMIT) TO MILLENNIUM CAMP
days.body: At the night you will Departure from Barafu Camp (4,640 m) and start summiting Kilimanjaro: Uhuru Peak (5,895 m). Simply the climb is relatively simple; though, the most challenging part is the high altitude where each pair of climbers will get a personal guide for the entire ascent to monitor your physical and mental conditions. After your successful ascent to Uhuru Peak, you can descend to the nearest glacier if you wish. Then you will return to Barafu Camp and after a 2-hour rest continue your descent to Millennium Camp (3,820 m). Note:Don’t forget that 90% of all accidents occur during the descent, including all broken arms and legs. Please pay attention to your feet, as there is a high risk of damaging your toenails. Change in Elevation: Barafu Camp (4,640 m), Uhuru Peak (5,895 m), Millennium Camp (3,820 m) Hiking distance: 15 km Hiking time: 8–12 hours ACCOMMODATION: Millennium Camp Mt. Kilimanjaro

days.heading: Day 7: MILLENNIUM CAMP TO MWEKA GATE
days.body: When you wake up at the camp you will feel relief from the reduction of the height and the satisfaction of reaching the summit. title: 7 Days Kilimanjaro Hike via Marangu Route
overview: Embark on a remarkable journey along the Marangu Route, one of the most classic and well-trodden paths to the summit of Mount Kilimanjaro. Known for its relatively gentle ascent and well-maintained huts, this route is ideal for those seeking a balance between challenge and comfort. The trek spans five days, taking you from the lush rainforests at Marangu Gate to the snow-covered peak of Uhuru, the highest point in Africa
facts:
Tour Name: 7 Days Kilimanjaro Hike via Marangu Route
Duration: 7 days
Countries: Tanzania
Itinerary: 6 day-by-day sections
Price: On request

days.heading: Day 1: Moshi: Marangu Gate to Mandara Huts
days.body:
• Distance: 7 km / 4.3 mi

• Hiking Time: 4-5 hours

• Habitat: Rainforest

• Elevation: 1,830m / 6,000ft to 2,740m / 9,000ft

Your adventure begins with a one-hour scenic drive from Moshi to the Kilimanjaro National Park Gate at Marangu. The drive will take you through the picturesque Village of Marangu. Upon arrival at the park gate, we will complete the necessary registration formalities while observing the bustling activities of other trekkers and their crews. Once the permits are issued, the trek commences. This day leads you through the lush rainforest, characterized by its dense vegetation, towering trees, and abundant birdlife. Your guide will enrich the experience by pointing out various local flora and fauna. As you ascend, be prepared for the trail’s sometimes muddy and slippery conditions, gaiters and trekking poles are highly recommended to ensure stability. You will reach Mandara Huts in the late afternoon, where you can relax and enjoy your first night on the mountain

days.heading: Day 2: Mandara Huts to Horombo Huts
days.body:
• Distance: 11 km / 6.8 mi

• Hiking Time: 6-8 hours

• Habitat: Moorland

• Elevation: 2,740m / 9,000ft to 3,690m / 12,100ft

After a restful night and a hearty breakfast, you will leave the rainforest behind and continue on an ascending path. Today’s trek takes you through the heathland, where you will encounter unique plant species such as giant lobelias and groundsels. As you climb higher, the landscape gradually transforms into open moorland, characterized by small shrubs and expansive views. A lunch stop halfway offers a chance to rest and enjoy the stunning views of Mawenzi Peak. The day concludes as you reach Horombo Huts, situated beneath the impressive Kibo Summit. Temperatures at this altitude begin to drop, so it’s important to stay warm as you settle in for the night

days.heading: Day 3: Horombo Huts to Kibo Huts
days.body:
• Distance: 10 km / 6.2 mi

• Hiking Time: 6-8 hours

• Habitat: Semi-Desert

• Elevation: 3,690m / 12,100ft to 4,695m / 15,400ft

Following breakfast, you will continue ascending through the diminishing heathland, which gradually gives way to a barren, rocky landscape resembling a lunar terrain. This day’s trek will take you across the Saddle, a broad, desolate plain connecting Mawenzi and Kibo peaks. During lunch break, you’ll have time to take in the surreal surroundings and mentally prepare for the upcoming summit attempt. The trail continues until you reach Kibo Huts in the afternoon, where you will rest and acclimatize in preparation for the early morning summit push

days.heading: Day 4: Summit Day: Kibo Huts to Uhuru Peak, then Descent to Horombo Huts
days.body:
• Ascent: 4 km / 2.5 mi | 5-7 hours

• Descent: 14 km / 8.7 mi | 5-6 hours

• Habitat: Glaciers, Snow-Capped Summit

• Elevation: 4,695m / 15,400ft to 5,895m / 19,340ft (Uhuru Peak), then descending to 3,690m / 12,100ft

Your summit day begins early, typically between midnight and 2am, under the cover of darkness. This is the most challenging day both mentally and physically. The trail ascends in a switchback pattern, navigating through scree and potentially snow, as you make your way towards Gillman’s Point on the crater rim. After a short rest at Gillman’s Point, where you can witness the magnificent sunrise, you’ll continue your final ascent to Uhuru Peak, the highest point on Mount Kilimanjaro and the entire African continent. Upon reaching Uhuru Peak, take a moment to celebrate your incredible achievement with photos and perhaps a few tears of joy. The descent begins soon after, retracing your steps back to Kibo Huts for a brief rest and lunch. The journey continues as you descend to Horombo Huts for your last night on the mountain. Meal Inclusion: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner Accommodation: Horombo Huts

days.heading: Day 5: Horombo Huts to Marangu Gate, Return to Moshi
days.body:
• Distance: 18 km / 11.2 mi

• Hiking Time: 6-7 hours

• Habitat: Rainforest

• Elevation: 3,690m / 12,100ft to 1,830m / 6,000ft

On the final day of your trek, enjoy a leisurely breakfast and a heartfelt farewell ceremony with your trekking team. It’s time to express your gratitude and provide tips to your guides, cooks, and porters before beginning the descent. The path takes you back through the rainforest, with a stop at Mandara Huts for lunch. The trail can be steep, muddy, and wet, so gaiters and trekking poles are again recommended. Upon reaching the Marangu Gate, you will receive your summit certificates, commemorating your successful climb of Mount Kilimanjaro. A vehicle will be waiting to transfer you back to your hotel in Moshi, where a well-deserved hot shower, a hearty dinner, and a chance to celebrate your remarkable accomplishment await. Meal Inclusion: Breakfast, Lunch

days.heading: Day 7: Airport Drop: Off
days.body:
This day, depending on your flight schedule, you will be transferred to the airport for your onward journey. Safe travels, and we hope you have enjoyed your Kilimanjaro adventure! PRICE INCLUDES****

title: 7 Days Rongai Route Kilimanjaro
overview: Visit Tanzania and take part in hiking the Kilimanjaro via the Rongai route on this 7 Days Rongai Route Kilimanjaro Hiking Safari. to book this safari
facts:

Duration: 7 days
Countries: Tanzania
Itinerary: 9 day-by-day sections
Price: On request

days.heading: Day 1: ARR IVAL
days.body: Touch down at the Kilimanjaro International Airport where your own personal driver will be waiting to greet you. Let your driver whisk you away to your chosen hotel in the bright and bustling city of Moshi – gateway to Tanzania. In the evening you will enjoy a quick briefing which will be conducted by professional Mountain Guide about your 7 Days Rongai Route Kilimanjaro trekking, and to ensure if you are ready for climbing

days.heading: Day 2: NALEMURU GATE TO SIMBA CAMP
days.body:
A guide and a mountain support crew will arrive at the hotel in the morning in order to meet you and hold a quick briefing, after which you will travel by vehicle to Kilimanjaro National Park’s northern entrance: Nalemuru Gate (2,020 m) to start your 7 Days Rongai Route Kilimanjaro. After the quick formality of acquiring climbing permits and registering with the search and rescue service, the group will start trekking up to Simba Camp (2,625 m). Your trek this day will be moderate and take you through coniferous forest up Kilimanjaro’s northern slope. Remember not to hurry and always keep a comfortable pace. By the time you reach the camp, our professional mountain crew will prepare everything necessary, put tents and cook dinner for you. This will be your first day at this altitude, so it is strongly recommended you heed the following instructions from this point on

• Abstain from consuming alcohol and caffeine

• Drink over 4 liters of bottled water daily (little by little, frequently)

• Take a Diamox pill to help alleviate symptoms of altitude sickness. Most mountain climbers take Diamox in the morning, before they start their ascent, in order to reduce discomfort associated with altitude sickness. We recommend you consult your doctor prior to the trip in case of potential allergies

At night you may experience discomfort associated with acclimatization to the high altitude: because of a reduction in your waking breathing pattern, your body gets less oxygen than during the day. Taking altitude into account, you may therefore start feeling sick and have a headache. Pay attention to your own body and tell your guide if you start feeling any symptoms of altitude sickness. Change in Elevation: Nalemuru Gate (2,020 m), Simba Camp (2,625 m) Hiking distance: 8 km Hiking time: 3–4 hours

days.heading: Day 3: SIMBA CAMP TO SECOND CAVE CAMP
days.body:
Early in the morning after breakfast, the group will depart from Simba Camp to start trekking towards your second high altitude camp: Second Cave Camp (3,480 m). This route is rather easy and will only take around 3 hours, so when you reach the camp you will still have ample time to rest and explore the surrounding area. After lunch you will have a couple hours to rest, followed by an acclimatization hike in the direction of Kikilewa Camp (3,630 m) on a stretch of the Rongai Route at a short distance with a 100-meter gain in altitude, after which you will hike back down to Second Cave Camp

NB: The acclimatization hike is an easy trek with a slight gain in altitude done in order to speed up the acclimatization process. You should take the acclimatization hikes very seriously. They help increase your chances of successfully summiting Kilimanjaro and save you from the consequences of altitude sickness. Trekking from Simba Camp to Second Cave Camp: Altitude gain: Simba Camp (2,625 m), Second Cave Camp (3,480 m) Walking distance: 4 km Duration: 2–3 hrs Acclimatization hike: Altitude gain: Second Cave Camp (3,480 m), Kikilewa Camp (3,580 m) Walking distance: 2.5 km Duration: 1–2 hrs ACCOMMODATION: Second Cave Camp Mt. Kilimanjaro

days.heading: Day 4: SECOND CAVE CAMP TO KIKILEWA CAMP
days.body: After breakfast you will begin trekking to Kikilewa Camp (3,630 m), where you can see Kibo Volcano at its finest (barring cloudy weather). This will be a relief day, so after lunch you will have time to sleep before the next trekking towards Mawenzi Tarn Camp. In the evening after dinner the guide will check health conditions of the each person of the group and give the necessary instructions for tomorrow’s trekking. Altitude gain: Second Cave Camp (3,480 m), Kikilewa Camp (3,630 m) Walking distance: 5 km Duration: 3–4 hrs

days.heading: Day 5: KIKELELWA TO MAWENZI TARN CAMP
days.body: Early wakeup, breakfast and the start of trekking to Mawenzi Tarn Camp, which is situated at the foot of Mawenzi Volcano, Kilimanjaro’s second summit. When you reach the camp, you will have lunch and a two-hour rest, after which there will be an acclimatization hike towards Mawenzi Volcano with a 200-meter gain in altitude, followed by a hike back down to Mawenzi Tarn Camp, where you will have dinner in the evening

days.heading: Day 6: MAWENZI TURN CAMP TO KIBO CAMP
days.body: This day will be spent trekking towards Kibo Summit Camp (4,700 m). The landscape will change significantly to give way to a rocky semi desert. The actual trekking is not very difficult; just remember to stick with an appropriate pace to keep up your strength for the trekking to Kilimanjaro’s summit. When you reach the camp, we recommend you sleep well, avoid strenuous activity, and drink as much as you can, because that very night you will be ascending Uhuru Peak (5,895 m). Altitude gain: Mawenzi Tarn Camp (4,310 m), Kibo Camp (4,700 m) Walking distance: 9 km Duration: 5–6 hrs

days.heading: Day 7: UHURU PEAK (SUMMIT) TO HOROMBO CAMP
days.body: The team will depart School Hut Camp with its elevation of 4,715 m at night. The trek up to Uhuru Peak’s 5,895 m puts more of a strain on your cardiovascular system than your muscles as the high altitude takes its toll on your body despite the moderate gradient of the climb. One guide will be assigned to every two climbers, constantly evaluating their fitness over the duration of this part of the climb. A walk on the nearest glacier can be undertaken upon reaching the summit. The descent to 3,720 m at Horombo Camp will include a 2-hour rest stop at Kibo Camp. It is highly advisable to keep in mind that 9 out of 10 climbing accident happen on the way down, so watch your step! Altitude gain: Kibo Camp (4,700 m) - School Hut Camp (4,715 m) - Uhuru Peak (5,895 m) - Horombo Camp (3,720 m) Walking distance: 21 km Duration: 12–14 hrs ACCOMMODATION: Horombo Camp Mt. Kilimanjaro

days.heading: Day 8: HOROMBO CAMP TO MARANGU GATE
days.body: You will be offered a warm breakfast in the morning, after which we will head for the Kilimanjaro National Park’s exit: Marangu Gate (1,860 m). After your descent the whole group will gather to congratulate you, and then you will have the chance to share your opinions on the trip in the guestbook. Lastly, we will present you with your commemorative certificates (in our office) and provide you a transfer back to the hotel. Change in Elevation: Horombo Camp (3,720 m), Marangu Gate (1,860 m) Hiking distance: 18 km Hiking time: 5–6 hours ACCOMMODATION: Planet Lodge Arusha

days.heading: Day 8: Departures
days.body:
After getting some rest and refreshment at the hotel, your driver guide will take you to the airport ready for your flight back home

The trek is not that much difficult and you will be able to see view of Africa and the unique flora and fauna of Kilimanjaro and surrounding area. You will arrive for lunch and after 2 hours rest you will complete acclimatization hike towards Lava Tower Camp that features a 200 meter gain in altitude

days.heading: Day 4: SHIRA 2 TO THE LAVA TOWER TO BARRRANCO CAMP
days.body: A long trek from Shira 2 Camp (3,900 m)to Barranco Camp (3,960 m). This route has a lot of ascents and descents at over 4600 meters. It might be difficult, and you may feel some discomfort, but in order to successfully acclimate to the altitude you have to spend at least 1–2 hours here, so this is where lunch will be. Here you can see the famous Barranco Wall, impressive in both its massive size and steepness!

days.heading: Day 5: BARRANCO CAMP TO KARANGA CAMP
days.body:
Early wakeup, breakfast and the start of summiting Barranco Wall (we recommend you leave the camp as early as possible to avoid crowds of the other groups, After the climb you can have a rest and take photos in front of the Kibo volcano. Then you start a more difficult hike to Karanga Camp, which features numerous ascents and descents during the route, but don’t worry: our guides are experts at choosing an optimal pace for the group. After reaching the camp you will be offered Hot lunch. After a couple of hours you will have to complete an acclimatization hike in the direction of Barafu Camp with a 300-meter gain in altitude, and then descent back down to the camp

*Note:The acclimatization hike is an easy trek with a slight gain in altitude done in order to speed up the acclimatization process. You should take the acclimatization hikes very seriously. Their help increase your chances of successfully summiting Kilimanjaro and save you from the consequences of altitude sickness.*Trekking from Barranco Camp to Karanga Camp: Change in Elevation: Barranco Camp (3,960 m), Karanga Camp (4,035 m) Hiking distance: 5 km Hiking time: 4–5 hours Acclimatization hike: Change in Elevation: Karanga Camp (4,035 m), Destination point en route to Barafu Camp (4,270 m) Hiking distance: 2.5 km Hiking time: 1–2 hours

days.heading: Day 6: KARANGA CAMP TO BARAFU CAMP
days.body: In the morning after breakfast you begin your way to Barafu Summit Camp (4,640 m), the starting point for a night summiting Uhuru Peak (5,895 m). Our team will set up a camp for you ahead of time, including tents and sleeping bags, so you can relax. After regaining strength, you have to complete an acclimatization hike towards the intermediate Kosovo Summit Camp (4,800 m) and then back to Barafu Camp, where you will be served a hot dinner. It is better to spend the remainder of the day resting and sleeping before night summiting. Trekking from Karanga Camp to Barafu Camp: Change in Elevation: Karanga Camp (4,035 m), Barafu Camp (4,640 m) Hiking distance: 6 km Hiking time: 4–5 hours Acclimatization hike: Change in Elevation: Barafu Camp (4,640 m), Kosovo Camp (4,800 m) Hiking distance: 2 km Hiking time: 1–2 hours ACCOMMODATION: Barafu Camp Mt. Kilimanjaro

days.heading: Day 7: BARAFU CAMP TO UHURU (SUMMIT) TO MILLENNIUM CAMP
days.body: At the night you will Departure from Barafu Camp (4,640 m) and start summiting Kilimanjaro: Uhuru Peak (5,895 m). Simply the climb is relatively simple; though, the most challenging part is the high altitude where each pair of climbers will get a personal guide for the entire ascent to monitor your physical and mental conditions. After your successful ascent to Uhuru Peak, you can descend to the nearest glacier if you wish. Then you will return to Barafu Camp and after a 2-hour rest continue your descent to Millennium Camp (3,820 m). Note:Don’t forget that 90% of all accidents occur during the descent, including all broken arms and legs. Please pay attention to your feet, as there is a high risk of damaging your toenails. Change in Elevation: Barafu Camp (4,640 m), Uhuru Peak (5,895 m), Millennium Camp (3,820 m) Hiking distance: 15 km Hiking time: 8–12 hours

days.heading: Day 8: MILLENNIUM CAMP TO MWEKA GATE
days.body: When you wake up at the camp you will feel relief from the reduction of the height and the satisfaction of reaching the summit. After a breakfast, you will start descending to the park’s exit: Mweka gate (1,650 m). Here the whole group will gather to congratulate you, followed by offering you a chance to share your opinions on the climb in the guestbook. Lastly, you will be presented with your commemorative certificates in our office and provide you a transfer back to the hotel. Change in Elevation: Millennium Camp (3,820 m), Mweka Gate (1,650 m) Hiking distance: 12 km Hiking time: 4–5 hour

days.heading: Day 9: Departures
days.body:
After getting some rest and refreshment at the hotel, your driver guide will take you to the airport ready for your flight back home. ACCOMMODATION: NONE

title: 8 Days Lemosho Route Kilimanjaro Hiking Safari
overview: Visit Tanzania and take part in hiking Kilimanjaro via the Lemosho route on this 8 Days Lemosho Route Kilimanjaro Hiking Safari. to book this safari
facts:
Tour Name: 8 Days Lemosho Route Kilimanjaro Hiking Safari
Duration: 8 days
Countries: Tanzania
Itinerary: 10 day-by-day sections
Price: On request

days.heading: Day 1: Arrival
days.body: Touch down at Kilimanjaro International Airport, where your own personal driver will be waiting to greet you. Let your driver whisk you away to your chosen hotel in the bright and bustling city of Moshi, gateway to Tanzania. In the evening you will enjoy a quick briefing, conducted by a professional mountain guide, about your trek, and to confirm that you are ready for climbing

days.heading: Day 2: Londorossi Gate and Starting Point to Mti Mkubwa Camp
days.body:
A guide and a mountain support crew will arrive at the hotel in the morning to meet you and hold a pre-trekking briefing, after which you will travel by vehicle (roughly 3 to 4 hours) to Kilimanjaro National Park’s western entrance: Londorossi Gate (2,200 m). After the quick formality of acquiring climbing permits and registering with the search and rescue service, the group will start trekking towards the first camp of the route: Mti Mkubwa Camp (2,780 m). Raincoats are necessary on this day in particular, as you will be walking through rainforest. By the time you reach the camp, our professional mountain crew will have prepared everything necessary, pitched the tents, and cooked lunch for you. After lunch the group will depart on an acclimatization hike towards Shira 1 Camp that features a 300 meter gain in altitude, after which you will hike back down to Mti Mkubwa Camp, where a hot dinner will be waiting

This will be your first day at this altitude, so it is strongly recommended you heed the following instructions from this point on

• Abstain from consuming alcohol and caffeine

• Drink over 4 liters of bottled water daily (little by little, frequently)

• Take a Diamox pill to help alleviate symptoms of altitude sickness. Most climbers take Diamox in the morning, before they start their ascent, to reduce discomfort associated with altitude sickness. We recommend you consult your doctor prior to the trip in case of potential allergies

At night you may experience discomfort associated with acclimatizing to the high altitude: because of a reduction in your breathing pattern while sleeping, your body gets less oxygen than during the day. You may start feeling unwell and have a headache. Pay attention to your own body and tell your guide if you start feeling any symptoms of altitude sickness

• Change in elevation: Londorossi Gate (2,200 m) to Mti Mkubwa Camp (2,780 m)

• Hiking distance: 6 km

• Hiking time: 3–4 hours

• Acclimatization hike: Mti Mkubwa Camp (2,780 m) to a point en route to Shira 1 Camp (3,095 m); 2 km; about 1 hour

• Accommodation: Mti Mkubwa Camp, Mt. Kilimanjaro

days.heading: Day 3: Mti Mkubwa Camp to Shira 1 Camp
days.body:
An early wakeup, breakfast, and a gradual trek upwards to 3,500 meters, where for the first time you will be able to see stunning views of the Shira Plateau and Kibo Volcano. The passage from Mti Mkubwa Camp to the second high-altitude camp, Shira 1 Camp (3,505 m), is rather easy and takes about 5 to 6 hours. This allows you to start the acclimatization process gradually, which is a mainstay of good trekking. When you reach the camp, your team of specialists will cook you lunch and you will have the chance to rest in your tent or walk around the nearby area

• Change in elevation: Mti Mkubwa Camp (2,780 m) to Shira 1 Camp (3,505 m)

• Hiking distance: 5 km

• Hiking time: 5–6 hours

• Accommodation: Shira 1 Camp, Mt. Kilimanjaro

days.heading: Day 4: Shira 1 Camp to Shira 2 Camp
days.body:
Departing from Shira 1 Camp (3,505 m), a light trek takes you towards the next high-altitude camp: Shira 2 Camp (3,900 m). This trek is not difficult, and you will be able to enjoy spectacular views of Africa and the unique flora of Kilimanjaro and the surrounding area. Shira 2 Camp is the best place on the trip to see Mount Meru (the fifth-highest summit in Africa), weather permitting. When you arrive at camp you will have lunch, and after a two-hour rest everyone will complete an acclimatization hike towards Lava Tower that features a 300 meter gain in altitude

• Change in elevation: Shira 1 Camp (3,505 m) to Shira 2 Camp (3,900 m)

• Hiking distance: 7 km

• Hiking time: 3–4 hours

• Acclimatization hike: Shira 2 Camp (3,900 m) to a point en route to Lava Tower (4,270 m); 2 km; 1–2 hours

• Accommodation: Shira 2 Camp, Mt. Kilimanjaro

days.heading: Day 5: Shira 2 Camp to Lava Tower to Barranco Camp
days.body:
After breakfast you will leave Shira 2 Camp (3,900 m) and start your way to a key point of the route: Lava Tower (4,630 m). This section has many ascents and descents that end at a camp over 4,600 meters. It can be difficult, and you may feel some discomfort, but in order to successfully acclimate you should spend at least 1 to 2 hours here, so this is where lunch will be. You will then descend to Barranco Camp (3,960 m). Here you can see the famous Barranco Wall, impressive in both its size and steepness. The next day you will climb it, but don’t worry: it features a very manageable hiking trail

• Change in elevation: Shira 2 Camp (3,900 m) to Lava Tower (4,630 m) to Barranco Camp (3,960 m)

• Hiking distance: 12 km

• Hiking time: 6–8 hours

• Accommodation: Barranco Camp, Mt. Kilimanjaro

days.heading: Day 6: Barranco Camp to Karanga Camp
days.body:
Early wakeup, breakfast, and the start of summiting the Barranco Wall (we recommend you leave camp as early as possible to avoid the crowds from other groups). After the climb you can rest and take photos in front of the Kibo volcano. Then you start a more demanding hike to Karanga Camp, which features numerous ascents and descents, but don’t worry: our guides are experts at choosing an optimal pace for the group. After reaching the camp you will be offered a hot lunch. A couple of hours later you will complete an acclimatization hike in the direction of Barafu Camp with a 300 meter gain in altitude, then descend back to camp

• Change in elevation: Barranco Camp (3,960 m) to Karanga Camp (4,035 m)

• Hiking distance: 5 km

• Hiking time: 4–5 hours

• Acclimatization hike: Karanga Camp (4,035 m) to a point en route to Barafu Camp (4,270 m); 2.5 km; 1–2 hours

• Accommodation: Karanga Camp, Mt. Kilimanjaro

days.heading: Day 7: Karanga Camp to Barafu Camp
days.body:
In the morning after breakfast you begin your way to Barafu Summit Camp (4,640 m), the starting point for a night summit of Uhuru Peak (5,895 m). Our team will set up camp for you ahead of time, including tents and sleeping bags, so you can relax. After regaining your strength, you will complete an acclimatization hike towards the intermediate Kosovo Summit Camp (4,800 m) and then return to Barafu Camp, where you will be served a hot dinner. It is best to spend the remainder of the day resting and sleeping before the night summit

• Change in elevation: Karanga Camp (4,035 m) to Barafu Camp (4,640 m)

• Hiking distance: 6 km

• Hiking time: 4–5 hours

• Acclimatization hike: Barafu Camp (4,640 m) to Kosovo Camp (4,800 m); 2 km; 1–2 hours

• Accommodation: Barafu Camp, Mt. Kilimanjaro

days.heading: Day 8: Barafu Camp to Uhuru Peak (Summit) to Millennium Camp
days.body:
At night you will depart from Barafu Camp (4,640 m) and start summiting Kilimanjaro to Uhuru Peak (5,895 m). The climb itself is relatively straightforward; the most challenging part is the high altitude, which is why each pair of climbers gets a personal guide for the entire ascent to monitor your physical and mental condition. After your successful ascent to Uhuru Peak, you can descend to the nearest glacier if you wish. You will then return to Barafu Camp and, after a two-hour rest, continue your descent to Millennium Camp (3,820 m)

• Change in elevation: Barafu Camp (4,640 m) to Uhuru Peak (5,895 m) to Millennium Camp (3,820 m)

• Hiking distance: 15 km

• Hiking time: 8–12 hours

• Accommodation: Millennium Camp, Mt. Kilimanjaro

days.heading: Day 9: Millennium Camp to Mweka Gate
days.body:
When you wake at camp you will feel relief from the lower altitude and the satisfaction of having reached the summit. After breakfast, you will start descending to the park’s exit at Mweka Gate (1,650 m). Here the whole group gathers to congratulate you, and you will have the chance to share your thoughts on the climb in the guestbook. Finally, you will be presented with your commemorative certificates at our office before your transfer back to the hotel

• Change in elevation: Millennium Camp (3,820 m) to Mweka Gate (1,650 m)

• Hiking distance: 12 km

• Hiking time: 4–5 hours

• Accommodation: Planet Lodge, Arusha

days.heading: Day 10: Departure
days.body:
After some rest and refreshment at the hotel, your driver-guide will take you to the airport, ready for your flight back home

title: 8 Days Northern Circuit Route Kilimanjaro Hiking Safari
overview: Visit Tanzania and take part in hiking the Kilimanjaro via the Northern Circuit Route on this 8 Days Northern Circuit Route Kilimanjaro Hiking Safari. to book this safari
facts:
Tour Name: 8 Days Northern Circuit Route Kilimanjaro Hiking Safari
Duration: 8 days
Countries: Kenya, Tanzania
Itinerary: 8 day-by-day sections
Price: On request

days.heading: Day 1: Arrival
days.body:
Touch down at the Kilimanjaro International Airport where your own personal driver will be waiting to greet you. Let your driver whisk you away to your chosen hotel in the bright and bustling city of Moshi– gateway to Tanzania

In the evening you will enjoy a quick briefing which will be conducted by professional Mountain Guide about your 8 Days Northern Circuit Route Kilimanjaro Hiking Safari trekking, and to ensure if you are ready for climbing. ACCOMMODATION: Plante Lodge Arusha

DAYS 2:HIGH ALTITUDE TRANSFER TO SHIRA 1 CAMP

Introductions and a short final orientation with your guides take place in the morning at your hotel before the 3 to 4-hour drive to Kilimanjaro National Park’s West gate: Londorossi (2,200 m). The guides will take care of the Park permits and registration formalities. A further 1-hour drive brings you to 3,500 m above sea level, which is where the trekking starts. The drop-off point affords stunning vistas of the Shira Plateau. The further walk to your first overnight camp at Shira 1 camp presents a modest physical challenge and allows for easy acclimation due to the modest increase in altitude. This will be your first night at high altitude, so adhere to the following rules from this point on

• Do not consume any alcohol or caffeine

• Keep hydrated by drinking no less than 4 l (about a gallon) of water a day

• We recommend that you take Diamox pills every morning prior to beginning the climb - this alleviates altitude sickness symptoms. Make sure to consult your physician on the use of Diamox before traveling

Nausea and headaches tend to occur at higher altitudes, especially at night. Do not panic if you experience these or any other symptoms but make sure to apprise your head guide of the situation immediately. Change in Elevation: Lemosho Glades (3,500 m), Shira 1 Camp (3,505 m) Hiking distance: 4 km Hiking time: 1 hour

days.heading: Day 3: SHIRA 1 CAMP TO SHIRA 2 CAMP
days.body:
This day brings yet another modest altitude gain of 300 m on the way from Shira 1 to Shira 2 Camp. The low physical demands of the trek will leave you with both time and energy to enjoy Kilimanjaro’s flora and- when the weather is favorable- Mount Meru, which is the 5th-highest mountain on the continent. A further acclimatization walk towards Lava Tower will follow lunch and a 2-hour rest period. This allows you to experience a further gain of 300 m. Trekking from Shira 1 Camp to Shira 2 Camp: Change in Elevation: Shira 1 Camp (3,505 m), Shira 2 Camp (3,900 m) Hiking distance: 7 km Hiking time: 3–4 hours Acclimatization hike: Change in Elevation: Shira 2 Camp (3,900 m), Destination point en route to Lava Tower (4,110 m) Hiking distance: 2 km Hiking time: 1–2 hours

DAYS 4:SHIRA 2 CAMP TO MOIR HUT VIA LAVA TOWER TREK

The group leaves the altitude of 3,900 m at Shira Camp and heads towards Lava Tower’s 4,630 m after breakfast. This part of the route is rife with ups and downs and may bring some discomfort. You will need to spend one or two hours at higher altitude in order to properly acclimatize yourself, so the lunch break will take place at Lava Tower itself. The afternoon part of the route climbs slightly before descending to Moir Hut Camp. Your guide may decide to bypass Lava Tower altogether, taking the porter trail instead, if any of the members of the group do not appear to have acclimatized properly. In this case the highest altitude reached will be 4,400, rather than 4,630 meters. Change in Elevation: Shira 2 Camp (3,900 m), Lava Tower (4,630 m), Moir Hut (4,200 m) Hiking distance: 14 km Hiking time: 5–7 hours ACCOMMODATION: Moir Hut Mt. Kilimanjaro

days.heading: Day 5: MOIR HUT CAMP TO BUFFALO CAMP
days.body: On this day you will have a rather long but at the same time easy trek. After a short steep climb out of Moir Valley you will start going around the northern slope of Kilimanjaro, and just like on the way to Lava Tower the path will be full of highs and lows, without any steep gains in altitude. This route passes close to the border with Kenya, so you will be treated to amazing views of the Tsavo and Amboseli Valleys. Change in Elevation: Moir Hut (4,200 m), Buffalo Camp (4,020 m) Hiking distance: 12 km Hiking time: 5–7 hours

days.heading: Day 6: BUFFALO CAMP TO 3 RD CAVE CAMP
days.body: You will finish trekking up the northern slope of Kilimanjaro and stop for the night in 3rd Cave Camp, where the route will meet up with the traditional Rongai route. On this day the trekking will be shorter than on the day before, and by this time your body will already have become completely acclimated to an altitude of 4,000 meters, which will contribute to your general feelings of well-being. Change in Elevation: Buffalo Camp (4,020 m), 3rd Cave Camp (3,870 m) Hiking distance: 8 km Hiking time: 4–6 hours ACCOMMODATION: 3rd Cave Camp Mt. Kilimanjaro

days.heading: Day 7: 3 RD CAVE CAMP TO SCHOOL HUT CAMP
days.body: On this day you will be trekking to the School Hut Summit Camp (4,750 m). The actual trekking is not very hard, so remember to just choose an appropriate pace in order to keep your strength up for the trekking to Kilimanjaro’s summit. When you reach the camp, we recommend you sleep well, avoid strenuous activity and drink as many fluids as you can, because that very night you will complete the trekking to Uhuru Peak (5,895 m). Change in Elevation: 3rd Cave Camp (3,870 m), School Hut (4,750 m) Hiking distance: 5 km Hiking time: 4–5 hours ACCOMMODATION: School Hut Camp Mt. Kilimanjaro

days.heading: Day 8: UHURU PEAK (SUMMIT) TO MILLENNIUM CAMP
days.body: Safety being the primary consideration during any summiting attempt, one guide will be nominated per every two climbers. His main responsibility is the monitoring of his designated clients’ health on the trek to Uhuru Peak’s 5,895 m. The climb, which starts at School Hut’s 4,750 m around midnight, though relatively easy technically, poses a challenge due to high altitude. A walk upon the nearest glacier is an option upon successful summiting. The group then descends to Barafu Camp for a two-hour lunch and rest break. The day ends at Millennium Camp’s 3,820 m. Please keep in mind, that 9/10 accidents occur during descent. Mind your step to avoid potential falls, breaks and damaged toes. Change in Elevation: School Hut (4,750 m), Uhuru Peak (5,895 m), Millennium Camp (3,820 m) Hiking distance: 6 km Hiking time: 6–8 hours ACCOMMODATION: Millennium Camp Mt. Kilimanjaro

days.heading: Day 9: MILLENIUM CAMP TO MWEKA GATE
days.body: Millennium Camp sits amidst a tropical rainforest. The lower altitude and feelings of accomplishment from having reached the summit make for a good night’s rest there. Hot breakfast is followed by your final descent to the Park’s exit gate- Mweka, at 1,650 m. This final stop before your transfer to our offices to receive your accomplishment certificates presents a good opportunity to recap the adventure with your support team. Finally, you will be driven to your hotel for a well-deserved rest. Change in Elevation: Millennium Camp (3,820 m), Mweka Gate (1,650 m) Hiking distance: 12 km Hiking time: 4–5 hours ACCOMMODATION: Plant Lodge Arusha

days.heading: Day 10: Departure
days.body: After getting some rest and refreshment at the hotel, your driver guide will take you to the airport ready for your flight back home after the great 8 Days Northern Circuit Route Kilimanjaro Hiking Safari
